title.zh: 卷三百十三 列傳第二百〇一 雲南土司一
title.raw: 卷三百十三 列傳第二百〇一 雲南土司一 Volume 313 Biographies 201: Yunnan Tribal Headmen 1

sentences.zh: 明洪武十四年，大軍至滇，梁王走死，遂置雲南府。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Hongwu of Ming, the great army reached Yunnan; the Prince of Liang fled and died; then Yunnan Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of the Hongwu reign, the Ming expedition reached Yunnan. The Prince of Liang fled and perished, and the court thereupon established Yunnan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 自是，諸郡以次來歸，垂及累世，規制鹹定。

translations.literal: From then on, the various prefectures submitted in succession; extending over successive generations, regulations were fully settled.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the prefectures submitted one after another, and over successive generations the administrative system was fully established.

sentences.zh: 統而稽之，大理、臨安以下，元江、永昌以上，皆府治也。

translations.literal: Taking them together in summary, from Dali and Lin'an downward and from Yuanjiang and Yongchang upward, all were prefecture seats.
translations.idiomatic: Taken together, from Dali and Lin'an southward to Yuanjiang and Yongchang northward, all were governed as prefectures.

sentences.zh: 孟艮、孟定等處則為司，新化、北勝等處則為州，或設流官，或仍土職。

translations.literal: Places such as Menggen and Mengding were established as commissions; places such as Xinhua and Beisheng as subprefectures; some had regular officials appointed, some retained hereditary native offices.
translations.idiomatic: Districts such as Menggen and Mengding were organized as native-official commissions, while Xinhua, Beisheng, and the like were made subprefectures; in some cases regular officials were installed, in others hereditary native posts were retained.

sentences.zh: 今以諸府州概列之土司者，從其始也。

translations.literal: Now listing the various prefectures and subprefectures under tribal headmen in general begins from this.
translations.idiomatic: The present practice of grouping the prefectures and subprefectures under tribal headmen begins here.

sentences.zh: 蓋滇省所屬，多蠻夷雜處，即正印為流官，亦必以土司佐之。

translations.literal: For Yunnan province mostly had barbarian tribes mixed together; even when regular seals were held by appointed officials, tribal headmen were necessary as assistants.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan was largely inhabited by mixed barbarian populations, so even where regular officials held formal authority, tribal headmen were still required to assist them.

sentences.zh: 而土司名目淆雜，難以縷析，故系之府州，以括其所轄。

translations.literal: But tribal headman titles were confused and hard to analyze in detail, so they are organized under prefectures and subprefectures to encompass their jurisdictions.
translations.idiomatic: Because the titles of tribal headmen were numerous and tangled and could not be sorted out in detail, they are arranged under prefectures and subprefectures to encompass their jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 而於土司事跡，止摭其大綱有關乎治亂興亡者載之，俾控馭者識所鑒焉。

translations.literal: As for tribal headmen affairs, only the general outline relevant to order and disorder and rise and fall is recorded, so those in control may know what to observe.
translations.idiomatic: As for the deeds of the tribal headmen, only the broad outline bearing on order and disorder and rise and fall is recorded, so those charged with governing them may know what lessons to heed.

sentences.zh: ○雲南土司一

translations.literal: ○ Yunnan Tribal Headmen, Part 1
translations.idiomatic: ○ Yunnan Tribal Headmen, Part 1

sentences.zh: 雲南大理臨安楚雄澄江景東廣南廣西鎮沅永寧順寧蒙化孟艮孟定

translations.literal: Yunnan, Dali, Lin'an, Chuxiong, Chengjiang, Jingdong, Guangnan, Guangxi, Zhenyuan, Yongning, Shunning, Menghua, Menggen, Mengding
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan, Dali, Lin'an, Chuxiong, Chengjiang, Jingdong, Guangnan, Guangxi, Zhenyuan, Yongning, Shunning, Menghua, Menggen, Mengding

sentences.zh: 〈（耿馬安撫司附）〉

translations.literal: (Gengma Pacification Commission appended)〉
translations.idiomatic: (with the Gengma Pacification Commission appended)〉

sentences.zh: 曲靖

translations.literal: Qujing
translations.idiomatic: Qujing

sentences.zh: 雲南，滇國也。

translations.literal: Yunnan was the state of Dian.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan was the land of Dian.

sentences.zh: 漢武帝時始置益州郡。

translations.literal: In the time of Emperor Wu of Han, Yizhou Commandery was first established.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Wu of Han, Yizhou Commandery was first established there.

sentences.zh: 蜀漢置雲南郡。

translations.literal: Shu Han established Yunnan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Shu Han created Yunnan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 隋置昆州，唐仍之。

translations.literal: Sui established Kun Prefecture; Tang retained it.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui established Kun Prefecture, which the Tang retained.

sentences.zh: 後為南詔蒙氏所據，改鄯闡府。

translations.literal: Later it was seized by the Meng clan of Nanzhao and renamed Shanchan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Meng clan of Nanzhao seized it and renamed it Shanchan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 歷鄭、趙、楊三氏，至大理段氏，以高智升領鄯闡牧，遂世其地。

translations.literal: It passed through the Zheng, Zhao, and Yang clans, down to the Duan clan of Dali; Gao Zhicheng held the Shanchan governorship, and thereafter they held the land for generations.
translations.idiomatic: It passed through the Zheng, Zhao, and Yang regimes until the Duan clan of Dali, when Gao Zhicheng held the governorship of Shanchan and his line held the region for generations.

sentences.zh: 元初，置鄯闡萬戶府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuan, Shanchan Ten-thousand-households Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yuan dynasty, the Shanchan Ten-thousand-households Office was established.

sentences.zh: 既改置中慶路，封子忽哥為雲南王鎮之，仍錄段氏子孫守其土。

translations.literal: It was then changed to Zhongqing Circuit; Prince Zihuoge was enfeoffed as Prince of Yunnan to guard it, while descendants of the Duan clan were still registered to hold their lands.
translations.idiomatic: It was then reorganized as Zhongqing Circuit, and Zihuoge was enfeoffed as Prince of Yunnan to govern it, while descendants of the Duan clan were still registered to hold their native lands.

sentences.zh: 忽哥死，其子嗣封為梁王。

translations.literal: When Zihuoge died, his son succeeded to the enfeoffment as Prince of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: After Zihuoge died, his son succeeded to the title of Prince of Liang.

sentences.zh: 洪武六年，遣翰林待制王祎等賫詔諭梁王，久留不遣，卒遇害。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Hongwu, Hanlin Attendant-drafter Wang Yi and others were sent bearing an edict to instruct the Prince of Liang; they were detained long and not sent back, and in the end were killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Hongwu, the court sent Hanlin Attendant-drafter Wang Yi and others with an edict to instruct the Prince of Liang. They were detained for a long time and never released, and were finally killed.

sentences.zh: 八年復遣湖廣行省參政吳雲往，中途為梁使所害。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Wu Yun, Administrative Commissioner of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, was again sent; on the way he was killed by the Liang prince's envoys.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Wu Yun, Administrative Commissioner of the Huguang Branch Secretariat, was sent again, but on the road he was killed by the Prince of Liang's agents.

sentences.zh: 十四年，征南將軍傅友德、藍玉、沐英率師至雲南城，梁王赴滇池死，定其地。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, the southern expedition generals Fu Youde, Lan Yu, and Mu Ying led troops to Yunnan city; the Prince of Liang went to Dianchi and died; the land was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, the southern expedition generals Fu Youde, Lan Yu, and Mu Ying led their armies to Yunnan city. The Prince of Liang went to Dianchi and died, and the region was pacified.

sentences.zh: 改中慶路為雲南府，置都指揮使司，命都督僉事馮誠署司事。

translations.literal: Zhongqing Circuit was changed to Yunnan Prefecture; a regional military commission was established, and Vice Commissioner-in-chief Feng Cheng was ordered to act as commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongqing Circuit was converted into Yunnan Prefecture, a regional military commission was established, and Vice Commissioner-in-chief Feng Cheng was ordered to administer it.

sentences.zh: 二月詔諭雲南諸郡蠻。

translations.literal: In the second month an edict instructed the various barbarian districts of Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month an edict was issued to instruct the barbarian districts throughout Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 十五年，友德等分兵攻諸蠻寨之未服者，土官楊苴乘隙作亂，集蠻眾二十余萬攻雲南城。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Youde and others divided troops to attack the barbarian stockades that had not submitted; native official Yang Ju seized the opportunity to rebel, gathering more than two hundred thousand barbarian followers to attack Yunnan city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, Youde and the others divided their forces to attack the unsubmitted barbarian stockades. The native official Yang Ju seized the opportunity to rebel and gathered more than two hundred thousand barbarian followers to assault Yunnan city.

sentences.zh: 時城中食少，士卒多病，寇至，都督謝熊、馮誠等攖城固守，賊不能攻，遂遠營為久困計。

translations.literal: At the time food in the city was scarce and the soldiers were mostly ill; when the bandits arrived, Commissioners Xie Xiong, Feng Cheng, and others held the city fast; the rebels could not take it, so they encamped far off with a plan for prolonged siege.
translations.idiomatic: Food in the city was scarce and the troops were widely sick. When the rebels arrived, Commissioners Xie Xiong and Feng Cheng and others held the walls and the enemy could not break in, so they pitched camp at a distance and planned a long siege.

sentences.zh: 時沐英方駐師烏撒，聞之，將驍騎還救。

translations.literal: At the time Mu Ying was encamped at Wusa; hearing of it, he led elite cavalry back to rescue.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Ying was then encamped at Wusa. On hearing the news, he led his elite cavalry back to relieve the city.

sentences.zh: 至曲靖，遣卒潛入報城中，為賊所得，紿之曰：「總兵官領三十萬眾至矣。」

translations.literal: Reaching Qujing, he sent soldiers secretly into the city to report; they were seized by the rebels, who deceived them saying, "The commander-in-chief is leading three hundred thousand men and has arrived.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Qujing, he sent men secretly into the city with word of his approach, but they were captured by the rebels, who deceived the garrison, saying, "The commander-in-chief is coming at the head of three hundred thousand men.

sentences.zh: 賊眾驚愕，拔營宵遁，走安寧、羅次、邵甸、富民、普寧、大理、江川等處，復據險樹柵，謀再寇。

translations.literal: The rebel host was startled and fled by night, running to Anning, Luoci, Shaodian, Fumin, Puning, Dali, Jiangchuan, and other places, again holding difficult terrain and building palisades, plotting to raid once more.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel host was thrown into alarm and broke camp in a night flight to Anning, Luoci, Shaodian, Fumin, Puning, Dali, Jiangchuan, and other places, where they again seized difficult ground, built palisades, and plotted a new attack.

sentences.zh: 英分調將士剿降之，斬首六萬余級，生擒四千余人，諸部悉定。

translations.literal: Ying divided and dispatched generals and soldiers to suppress and subdue them; more than sixty thousand heads were cut off and more than four thousand taken alive; all the tribes were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Ying divided his forces to suppress and subdue them. More than sixty thousand heads were taken and more than four thousand men captured alive, and all the tribes were pacified.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，英卒，命其子春襲封西平侯，仍鎮雲南。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year Ying died; his son Chun was ordered to succeed to the enfeoffment as Marquis of Xiping and still guard Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year Ying died. His son Chun was ordered to succeed as Marquis of Xiping and continue to guard Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 自英平雲南，在鎮十年，恩威著於蠻僥；

translations.literal: From the time Ying pacified Yunnan, he was stationed there ten years, and his grace and authority were manifest among the barbarian peoples;
translations.idiomatic: From the time Ying pacified Yunnan, he governed there for ten years, and his grace and authority were felt throughout the barbarian lands;

sentences.zh: 每下片楮，諸番部具威儀出郭叩迎，盥而後啟，曰：「此令旨也。」

translations.literal: Whenever a slip of paper was issued, the various tribal departments would go out beyond the walls with full ceremonial to bow in welcome, wash their hands and then open it, saying, "This is an order from on high.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever an order arrived on a slip of paper, the tribal departments would go out beyond the walls with full ceremony to bow in welcome, wash their hands, and only then open it, saying, "This is a command from on high.

sentences.zh: 沐氏亦皆能以功名世其家。

translations.literal: The Mu clan too were all able to pass down fame and achievement through their house for generations.
translations.idiomatic: The Mu clan too were able to pass down fame and achievement through their house for generations.

sentences.zh: 每大征伐，輒以征南將軍印授之，沐氏未嘗不在行間。

translations.literal: On every great campaign, the seal of Southern Expedition General was conferred on them; the Mu clan were never absent from the ranks.
translations.idiomatic: On every major campaign the seal of Southern Expedition General was conferred on them, and a member of the Mu clan was never absent from the field.

sentences.zh: 數傳而西平裔孫當襲侯，守臣爭之，謂滇人知有黔國公，不知西平侯也。

translations.literal: After several generations, a descendant of Xiping due to succeed to the marquisate was disputed by local officials, who said the people of Yunnan knew the Duke of Qian state but not the Marquis of Xiping.
translations.idiomatic: After several generations, when a descendant of Xiping was due to succeed to the marquisate, local officials objected, saying the people of Yunnan knew the Duke of Qian but not the Marquis of Xiping.

sentences.zh: 孝宗以為然，許之。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaozong thought it right and granted it.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozong agreed and granted the request.

sentences.zh: 自是，遂以公爵佩印，為故事。

translations.literal: From then on, wearing the ducal seal became precedent.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, holding the ducal title and wearing the seal became established precedent.

sentences.zh: 諸土司之進止予奪，皆咨稟。

translations.literal: The advancement, withdrawal, appointment, and dismissal of all tribal headmen were reported for approval.
translations.idiomatic: The appointment, dismissal, and advancement of all tribal headmen were submitted for approval.

sentences.zh: 及承平久，文網周密，凡事必與太監撫、按、三司會議後行，動多掣肘，土官子孫承襲有積至二三十年不得職者。

translations.literal: When peace had lasted long, the net of documents was close; every matter had to be discussed with the eunuch superintendent, the surveillance and pacification commissioners, and the three offices before action; movement was often checked; descendants of native officials waiting to succeed sometimes accumulated twenty or thirty years without receiving office.
translations.idiomatic: As peace lasted, the paperwork grew ever tighter: every matter had to be discussed with the eunuch superintendent, the surveillance and pacification commissioners, and the three provincial offices before anything could be done, and action was constantly hampered. Descendants of native officials sometimes waited twenty or thirty years without receiving their posts.

sentences.zh: 土官復慢令玩法，無所忌憚；

translations.literal: Native officials again treated orders lightly and played with the law, without fear;
translations.idiomatic: Native officials in turn treated orders lightly and evaded the law without fear;

sentences.zh: 待其罪大惡極，然後興兵征剿，致軍民日困，地方日壞。

translations.literal: Only when their crimes were great and evil extreme would troops be raised to suppress them, causing soldiers and people to grow daily distressed and the region daily to deteriorate.
translations.idiomatic: Only when their crimes had grown extreme would troops finally be raised against them, so that soldiers and civilians grew daily more distressed and the region daily more ruined.

sentences.zh: 大學士楊一清等因武定安銓之亂，痛切陳之。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Yang Yiqing and others, because of the rebellion of An Quan of Wuding, stated the matter painfully and directly.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Yang Yiqing and others, in the wake of the rebellion of An Quan of Wuding, submitted a forceful memorial on the subject.

sentences.zh: 黔國公沐紹勛亦以為言。

translations.literal: The Duke of Qian state Mu Shaoxun also spoke on it.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Qian, Mu Shaoxun, spoke on it as well.

sentences.zh: 雖得旨允行，亦不能更革。

translations.literal: Although an edict approved implementation, reform could not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Although an edict approved their proposals, nothing could actually be changed.

sentences.zh: 馴至神宗之世，朝廷惰俞，封疆敗壞日甚一日。

translations.literal: By the time of Emperor Shenzong, the court grew slack in assent, and the frontier deteriorated day by day.
translations.idiomatic: By the reign of Emperor Shenzong the court had grown slack, and the frontier deteriorated from day to day.

sentences.zh: 緬、莽之叛，皆土官之失職者導之。

translations.literal: The rebellions of Burma and Mang were all guided by tribal headmen who had lost their offices.
translations.idiomatic: The rebellions of Burma and Mang were all instigated by disaffected tribal headmen.

sentences.zh: 雖稍奏膚功，而滇南喪敗，卒由土官沙定洲之禍。

translations.literal: Although slight superficial achievements were reported, the loss and defeat of southern Yunnan in the end came from the disaster of the tribal headman Sha Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Although minor victories were reported, the ruin of southern Yunnan in the end came from the disaster wrought by the tribal headman Sha Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 沙定洲者，王弄山長官司沙源之子也。

translations.literal: Sha Dingzhou was the son of Sha Yuan, native prefect of Wangnong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Sha Dingzhou was the son of Sha Yuan, native prefect of Wangnong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 源驍勇有將材，萬歷中，數從征調有功，巡撫委以王弄副長官事。

translations.literal: Yuan was fierce and brave and had the talent of a general; in the Wanli reign he followed several campaigns with merit; the grand coordinator entrusted him with the affairs of deputy native prefect of Wangnong.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan was fierce and brave and showed the talent of a general. During the Wanli reign he took part in several campaigns with distinction, and the grand coordinator entrusted him with the post of deputy native prefect of Wangnong.

sentences.zh: 繼以征建水功，以安南長官司廢地畀之。

translations.literal: Later, for merit in the campaign against Jianshui, the abolished territory of the Annan native prefecture was granted him.
translations.idiomatic: Later, for his service in the campaign against Jianshui, he was granted the abolished territory of the Annan native prefecture.

sentences.zh: 後征東川、水西、馬龍山等處，全雲南會城，稱首功，累加至宣撫使，時號沙兵。

translations.literal: Later in campaigns against Dongchuan, Shuixi, Malong Mountain, and other places, he mustered the whole of Yunnan's provincial capital and was called foremost in merit, promoted cumulatively to Pacification Commissioner, and at the time was called the Sha troops.
translations.idiomatic: Later, in campaigns against Dongchuan, Shuixi, Malong Mountain, and other places, he mustered the forces of the whole Yunnan capital and was hailed as foremost in merit. He was promoted step by step to Pacification Commissioner and his forces were known as the Sha troops.

sentences.zh: 定洲，其仲子也。

translations.literal: Dingzhou was his second son.
translations.idiomatic: Dingzhou was his second son.

sentences.zh: 崇禎中，元謀土知州吾必奎叛。

translations.literal: In the Chongzhen reign, the native subprefect of Yuanmou, Wu Bikui, rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongzhen reign, Wu Bikui, the native subprefect of Yuanmou, rebelled.

sentences.zh: 總兵官沐天波剿之，調定洲從征。

translations.literal: The commander-in-chief Mu Tianbo suppressed him and summoned Dingzhou to join the campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Commander-in-chief Mu Tianbo moved to suppress him and ordered Dingzhou to join the campaign.

sentences.zh: 定洲不欲行，出怨言。

translations.literal: Dingzhou did not wish to go and uttered complaints.
translations.idiomatic: Dingzhou did not wish to go and voiced his resentment.

sentences.zh: 會奸徒饒希之、余錫朋者逋天波金，無以償。

translations.literal: It happened that the villains Rao Xizhi and Yu Xipeng owed Tianbo money and could not repay.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time the scoundrels Rao Xizhi and Yu Xipeng owed Tianbo money and could not repay it.

sentences.zh: 錫朋常出入土司家，誇黔府富盛。

translations.literal: Xipeng often went in and out of tribal headmen households, boasting of the wealth of the Qian mansion.
translations.idiomatic: Xipeng often visited the households of tribal headmen and boasted of the vast wealth of the Qian mansion.

sentences.zh: 定洲心動，陰結都司阮韻嘉諸人為內應。

translations.literal: Dingzhou's heart was moved; he secretly joined with Regional Vice Commander Ruan Yunjia and others as inside collaborators.
translations.idiomatic: Dingzhou's heart was stirred, and he secretly won Regional Vice Commander Ruan Yunjia and others as inside collaborators.

sentences.zh: 既定洲入城辭行，天波以家諱日不視事，定洲噪而入，焚劫其府。

translations.literal: When Dingzhou entered the city to take leave for the campaign, Tianbo, because it was the day of his family's taboo name, did not attend to business; Dingzhou clamored his way in and burned and plundered the mansion.
translations.idiomatic: When Dingzhou entered the city to take his leave for the campaign, Tianbo, observing the taboo day of a family death, was not attending to business. Dingzhou stormed in with a clamor and burned and plundered the mansion.

sentences.zh: 天波聞變，由小竇遁。

translations.literal: Tianbo heard of the uprising and escaped through a small opening.
translations.idiomatic: Tianbo heard of the uprising and fled through a small passage.

sentences.zh: 時寧州土司祿永命在城，方巷戰拒賊，從官周鼎止天波，留討賊。

translations.literal: At the time the Ningzhou tribal headman Lu Yongming was in the city, fighting the rebels in the lanes; attendant Zhou Ding stopped Tianbo and urged him to stay to attack the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: The Ningzhou tribal headman Lu Yongming was then in the city, fighting the rebels in the lanes. Attendant Zhou Ding stopped Tianbo and urged him to stay and attack the rebels.

sentences.zh: 天波疑鼎為定洲誘己，殺之，其母妻皆走城北自焚死。

translations.literal: Tianbo suspected Ding was luring him on Dingzhou's behalf and killed him; his mother and wife all fled to the north of the city and burned themselves to death.
translations.idiomatic: Tianbo suspected that Ding was luring him on Dingzhou's behalf and killed him. His mother and wife fled to the north of the city and burned themselves to death.

sentences.zh: 定洲據黔府，盤踞會城。

translations.literal: Dingzhou seized the Qian mansion and entrenched himself in the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: Dingzhou seized the Qian mansion and entrenched himself in the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 劫巡撫吳兆元，使題請代天波鎮滇，傳檄州縣，全滇震動。

translations.literal: He seized Grand Coordinator Wu Zhaoyuan and made him memorialize requesting to replace Tianbo in governing Yunnan; he issued proclamations to prefectures and counties, and all Yunnan was shaken.
translations.idiomatic: He seized Grand Coordinator Wu Zhaoyuan and forced him to memorialize asking that he replace Tianbo as governor of Yunnan. He issued proclamations to the prefectures and counties, and all Yunnan was shaken.

sentences.zh: 祿永命與石屏州龍在田俱引所部去。

translations.literal: Lu Yongming and Long Zaitian of Shiping Prefecture both led their followers away.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Yongming and Long Zaitian of Shiping Prefecture both withdrew with their followers.

sentences.zh: 天波走楚雄，金滄副使楊畏知奉調駐城中，謂天波曰：「公何不走永昌，使楚得為備，而公在彼掎角，首尾牽制之，上策也。」

translations.literal: Tianbo fled to Chuxiong; Vice Commissioner Yang Weizhi of Jincang, having received orders, was stationed in the city and said to Tianbo, "Why do you not go to Yongchang, so that Chuxiong can prepare defenses while you there pin them from both ends and check them front and rear? That is the best plan.
translations.idiomatic: Tianbo fled to Chuxiong, where Vice Commissioner Yang Weizhi of Jincang, having been ordered there, was stationed in the city. He said to Tianbo, "Why do you not withdraw to Yongchang? Let Chuxiong prepare its defenses while you hold the other flank and pin the enemy between us. That is the best plan.

sentences.zh: 天波從之。

translations.literal: Tianbo followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Tianbo agreed.

sentences.zh: 定洲至楚雄，城閉不得入，乃去。

translations.literal: Dingzhou reached Chuxiong; the city gates were closed and he could not enter, so he left.
translations.idiomatic: Dingzhou reached Chuxiong, but the gates were shut against him and he withdrew.

sentences.zh: 遣其黨王翔、李日芳等，攻陷大理、蒙化。

translations.literal: He sent his partisans Wang Xiang, Li Rifang, and others, who captured Dali and Menghua.
translations.idiomatic: He sent his partisans Wang Xiang, Li Rifang, and others, who captured Dali and Menghua.

sentences.zh: 畏知乘間檄城外居民盡入城，築陴浚隍，調土、漢兵守之。

translations.literal: Weizhi seized the interval to order all residents outside the walls into the city, built ramparts and deepened moats, and deployed native and Han troops to defend.
translations.idiomatic: Weizhi seized the moment to order all residents outside the walls into the city, strengthened the ramparts and deepened the moats, and deployed both native and Han troops to defend it.

sentences.zh: 定洲聞祿永命等各固守，不敢至永昌，恐畏知截其歸路，急還兵攻楚雄。

translations.literal: Dingzhou heard that Lu Yongming and others each held fast; he dared not go to Yongchang, fearing Weizhi would cut his return route, and hurriedly returned troops to attack Chuxiong.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that Lu Yongming and the others were holding firm, Dingzhou dared not advance on Yongchang, fearing that Weizhi would cut off his retreat, and hurried back to attack Chuxiong.

sentences.zh: 畏知坐城樓，賊發巨炮擊之，煙焰籠城櫓，眾謂畏知已死，而畏知端坐自如，賊相驚謂神。

translations.literal: Weizhi sat on the city tower; the rebels fired great cannon at it; smoke and flame enveloped the tower; the crowd thought Weizhi was already dead, yet Weizhi sat upright as before; the rebels looked at one another in alarm and called him a god.
translations.idiomatic: Weizhi sat on the city tower as the rebels fired great cannon at it. Smoke and flame engulfed the tower, and the defenders thought he must be dead, yet he sat upright as before. The rebels looked at one another in alarm and called him a god.

sentences.zh: 畏知伺賊間，輒出奇兵殺賊甚眾。

translations.literal: Weizhi watched for gaps among the rebels and repeatedly sent out surprise troops, killing very many rebels.
translations.idiomatic: Weizhi watched for openings among the rebels and repeatedly sent out surprise troops, killing great numbers of them.

sentences.zh: 賊引去，攻石屏不下，還攻寧州，祿永命戰死。

translations.literal: The rebels withdrew, attacked Shiping without success, returned to attack Ningzhou, and Lu Yongming died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels withdrew, failed to take Shiping, returned to attack Ningzhou, and Lu Yongming fell in battle.

sentences.zh: 賊計迤東稍稍定，乃復攻楚雄。

translations.literal: The rebels reckoned that the eastern region was gradually settling, and again attacked Chuxiong.
translations.idiomatic: Judging that the eastern region was gradually settling, the rebels again attacked Chuxiong.

sentences.zh: 分兵為七十二營，環城掘濠，為久困計。

translations.literal: They divided troops into seventy-two camps, dug moats around the city, and planned a long siege.
translations.idiomatic: They divided their forces into seventy-two camps, dug trenches around the city, and planned a prolonged siege.

sentences.zh: 會張獻忠死，其部將孫可望率余眾由遵義入黔，稱黔國焦夫人弟來復仇。

translations.literal: It happened that Zhang Xianzhong died; his subordinate general Sun Kewang led the remaining host from Zunyi into Guizhou, claiming to be the younger brother of Lady Jiao of Qian state come to take revenge.
translations.idiomatic: About this time Zhang Xianzhong died, and his lieutenant Sun Kewang led the remnant forces from Zunyi into Guizhou, claiming to be the younger brother of Lady Jiao of Qian come to take revenge.

sentences.zh: 民久困沙兵，喜其來，迎之。

translations.literal: The people, long distressed by the Sha troops, were glad of their coming and welcomed them.
translations.idiomatic: The people, long harried by the Sha troops, were glad to see them come and welcomed them.

sentences.zh: 定洲解楚雄圍，迎戰於草泥關，大敗，遁阿迷。

translations.literal: Dingzhou lifted the siege of Chuxiong and met them in battle at Caoni Pass; he was greatly defeated and fled to Ami.
translations.idiomatic: Dingzhou lifted the siege of Chuxiong and met them at Caoni Pass, where he was routed and fled to Ami.

sentences.zh: 可望破曲靖及交水，俱屠之。

translations.literal: Kewang captured Qujing and Jiaoshui and slaughtered both.
translations.idiomatic: Kewang took Qujing and Jiaoshui and put both to the sword.

sentences.zh: 遂由陸涼、宜良入雲南城，分遣李定國徇迤東諸府。

translations.literal: He then entered Yunnan city by way of Luliang and Yiliang, and separately dispatched Li Dingguo to subdue the various prefectures of the eastern circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He then entered Yunnan city by way of Luliang and Yiliang and dispatched Li Dingguo to subdue the prefectures of the eastern circuit.

sentences.zh: 而可望自率兵西出，畏知禦於啟明橋，兵敗，被執。

translations.literal: Kewang himself led troops west; Weizhi defended at Qiming Bridge, was defeated, and was captured.
translations.idiomatic: Kewang himself led his forces westward. Weizhi met him at Qiming Bridge, was defeated, and was captured.

sentences.zh: 可望聞其名，不殺，語之曰：「吾與爾共討賊，何如？」

translations.literal: Kewang heard his fame and did not kill him, saying to him, "Will you join me in attacking the bandits together?
translations.idiomatic: Kewang had heard of his reputation and did not kill him. He said, "Will you join me in attacking the rebels together?

sentences.zh: 畏知要以三事：「不用獻忠偽號，不殺百姓，不擄婦女，吾從爾。」

translations.literal: Weizhi made three conditions: "Do not use Xianzhong's false title, do not kill common people, do not seize women — then I will follow you."
translations.idiomatic: Weizhi set three conditions: "Do not use Xianzhong's false title, do not kill civilians, and do not seize women — then I will follow you."

sentences.zh: 可望皆許之。

translations.literal: Kewang promised all.
translations.idiomatic: Kewang agreed to all three.

sentences.zh: 即折箭相誓，乃以書諭天波如畏知言，天波亦來歸。

translations.literal: They immediately broke arrows to swear together; then by letter he instructed Tianbo as Weizhi had said, and Tianbo also came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: They broke arrows to seal their oath, and Kewang wrote to Tianbo as Weizhi had proposed. Tianbo submitted as well.

sentences.zh: 而李定國之徇臨安者，定洲部目李阿楚拒戰甚力。

translations.literal: As for Li Dingguo subduing Lin'an, Dingzhou's subordinate Li Achu resisted fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile, as Li Dingguo advanced on Lin'an, Dingzhou's officer Li Achu resisted fiercely.

sentences.zh: 定國穴地置炮，炮發城陷，遂入。

translations.literal: Dingguo tunneled underground to place cannon; when the cannon fired the city fell, and he entered.
translations.idiomatic: Dingguo tunneled under the walls to place cannon. When the guns fired, the city fell and he entered.

sentences.zh: 驅城中官民於城外白場殺之，凡七萬八千余人，斬獲不與焉。

translations.literal: He drove officials and common people in the city to the white field outside and killed them; in all more than seventy-eight thousand persons, not counting those cut down or captured in battle.
translations.idiomatic: He drove the officials and common people of the city to the white field outside the walls and slaughtered them — more than seventy-eight thousand in all, not counting those killed or captured in battle.

sentences.zh: 當時皆意定國破臨安，必襲阿迷，取定洲，乃僅掠臨安子女而回，所過無不屠滅。

translations.literal: At the time all thought that when Dingguo took Lin'an he would surely strike Ami and seize Dingzhou; yet he only plundered the women and children of Lin'an and returned, and wherever he passed there was none he did not slaughter and destroy.
translations.idiomatic: At the time everyone expected that once Dingguo took Lin'an he would strike Ami and capture Dingzhou. Instead he only seized the women and children of Lin'an and withdrew, slaughtering and destroying everywhere he passed.

sentences.zh: 迤西以畏知在軍，得保全。

translations.literal: The western circuit was preserved because Weizhi was in the army.
translations.idiomatic: The western circuit was spared because Weizhi was with the army.

sentences.zh: 始定洲歸，屯兵洱革龍，且借安南援自固。

translations.literal: At first when Dingzhou returned, he encamped troops at Ergelong and also sought Annan aid to secure himself.
translations.idiomatic: When Dingzhou first withdrew, he encamped at Ergelong and sought aid from Annan to secure his position.

sentences.zh: 會可望與定國不協，聲其罪，杖之百，責以取定洲自贖。

translations.literal: It happened that Kewang and Dingguo were not in accord; he proclaimed Dingguo's crimes, had him beaten one hundred strokes, and charged him to capture Dingzhou to redeem himself.
translations.idiomatic: Kewang and Dingguo had fallen out. Kewang proclaimed Dingguo's crimes, had him beaten one hundred strokes, and charged him to capture Dingzhou to redeem himself.

sentences.zh: 定國既至，定洲土目楊嘉方迎定洲就其營宴。

translations.literal: When Dingguo arrived, Dingzhou's native officer Yang Jiafang welcomed Dingzhou to his camp for a feast.
translations.idiomatic: When Dingguo arrived, Dingzhou's native officer Yang Jiafang welcomed Dingzhou to his camp for a feast.

sentences.zh: 定國偵知之，率兵圍營，相拒數日，乃出降。

translations.literal: Dingguo learned of it by reconnaissance, led troops to surround the camp, and after opposing one another several days, Dingzhou came out to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Dingguo learned of it through scouts, surrounded the camp with his troops, and after several days of fighting Dingzhou came out to surrender.

sentences.zh: 遂械定洲及妻萬氏數百人回雲南，剝其皮市中。

translations.literal: He then fettered Dingzhou and his wife Lady Wan and several hundred others and returned to Yunnan, flaying their skins in the market.
translations.idiomatic: He then bound Dingzhou, his wife Lady Wan, and several hundred others and brought them back to Yunnan, where their skins were flayed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 可望遂據滇，而天波卒走死於緬甸。

translations.literal: Kewang then seized Yunnan, and Tianbo in the end fled and died in Burma.
translations.idiomatic: Kewang then seized control of Yunnan, and Tianbo in the end fled and died in Burma.

sentences.zh: 大理，唐葉榆縣境也。

translations.literal: Dali was within the territory of Yeyu County of Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Dali lay within the territory of Yeyu County under the Tang.

sentences.zh: 麟德初，置姚州都督府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Linde, Yaozhou Regional Command was established.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Linde reign, Yaozhou Regional Command was established.

sentences.zh: 開元末，蒙詔皮羅閣建都於此，為南詔，治太和城。

translations.literal: At the end of Kaiyuan, Piluoge of Nanzhao built his capital here and made Nanzhao, governing Taihe city.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Kaiyuan reign, Piluoge of Nanzhao built his capital here, established Nanzhao, and governed from Taihe city.

sentences.zh: 至閣羅鳳，號大蒙國，異牟尋改大禮國。

translations.literal: Down to Geluofeng, he styled himself Great Meng State; Yimouxun changed it to Great Li State.
translations.idiomatic: Under Geluofeng the state was styled Great Meng; Yimouxun renamed it Great Li.

sentences.zh: 其後，鄭買賜、趙善政、楊幹貞互篡奪，至五代晉時，段思平得之，更號大理國。

translations.literal: Afterward Zheng Maidi, Zhao Shanzheng, and Yang Ganzhen seized power from one another in turn; by the Jin era of the Five Dynasties, Duan Siping obtained it and again styled it Dali State.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Zheng Maidi, Zhao Shanzheng, and Yang Ganzhen seized power from one another in turn. In the Jin era of the Five Dynasties, Duan Siping obtained it and again styled the realm Dali.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗取雲南，至大理，段智興降附，乃設都元帥，封智興為摩訶羅嵯，管領八方。

translations.literal: Emperor Xianzong of Yuan took Yunnan; reaching Dali, Duan Zhixing submitted and attached himself; a chief commander was then established, and Zhixing was enfeoffed as Maharaja to govern the eight directions.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xianzong of Yuan took Yunnan and reached Dali, Duan Zhixing submitted. A chief commander was established, and Zhixing was enfeoffed as Maharaja to govern the eight directions.

sentences.zh: 又以劉時中為宣撫使，同智興安輯其民。

translations.literal: Liu Shizhong was also made Pacification Commissioner to settle the people together with Zhixing.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shizhong was also appointed Pacification Commissioner to settle the people together with Zhixing.

sentences.zh: 段氏有大理，傳十世至寶。

translations.literal: The Duan clan held Dali and passed it down ten generations to Bao.
translations.idiomatic: The Duan clan held Dali and passed it down ten generations to Bao.

sentences.zh: 聞太祖開基江南，遣其叔段真由會川奉表歸款。

translations.literal: Hearing that the Founding Emperor had established the realm south of the Yangtze, he sent his uncle Duan Zhen from Huichuan to present a memorial submitting.
translations.idiomatic: When he heard that the Founding Emperor had established the realm south of the Yangtze, he sent his uncle Duan Zhen from Huichuan to present a memorial of submission.

sentences.zh: 洪武十四年，征南將軍傅友德克雲南，授段明為宣慰使。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Hongwu, the southern expedition general Fu Youde took Yunnan and appointed Duan Ming Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Hongwu, the southern expedition general Fu Youde took Yunnan and appointed Duan Ming Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 明遣都使張元亨貽征南將軍書曰：「大理乃唐交綏之外國，鄯闡實宋斧畫之余邦，難列營屯，徒勞兵甲。

translations.literal: Ming sent Commissioner Zhang Yuanheng with a letter to the southern expedition general saying, "Dali is a foreign state beyond Tang Jiaosui; Shanchan is truly a remnant realm left by Song axe-strokes. It is hard to array camps and garrisons — only to weary soldiers and armor.
translations.idiomatic: Ming sent Commissioner Zhang Yuanheng with a letter to the southern expedition general, saying, "Dali is a foreign state beyond Tang Jiaosui; Shanchan is truly a remnant realm left outside the Song frontier. It is hard to array camps and garrisons — only to weary soldiers and armor.

sentences.zh: 請依唐、宋故事，寬我蒙、段，奉正朔，佩華篆，比年一小貢，三年一大貢。」

translations.literal: We ask to follow Tang and Song precedent, sparing our Meng and Duan, observing the correct calendar, wearing the imperial seal, with a small tribute every year and a great tribute every three years."
translations.idiomatic: We ask to follow Tang and Song precedent, sparing our Meng and Duan lines, observing the correct calendar, wearing the imperial seal, with a small tribute every year and a great tribute every three years."

sentences.zh: 友德怒，辱其使。

translations.literal: Youde was angry and humiliated the envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Youde was angry and humiliated the envoy.

sentences.zh: 明再貽書曰：「漢武習戰，僅置益州。

translations.literal: Ming sent another letter saying, "Emperor Wu of Han practiced warfare and only established Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ming sent another letter, saying, "Emperor Wu of Han practiced warfare and only established Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 元祖親征，祗緣鄯闡。

translations.literal: The Yuan ancestor campaigned in person, solely because of Shanchan.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan founder campaigned in person solely because of Shanchan.

sentences.zh: 乞賜班師。」

translations.literal: We beg you to grant withdrawal of the army."
translations.idiomatic: We beg you to withdraw the army."

sentences.zh: 友德答書曰：「大明龍飛淮甸，混一區宇。

translations.literal: Youde answered with a letter saying, "Great Ming rose in the Huai region and unified the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Youde answered with a letter, saying, "Great Ming rose in the Huai region and unified the realm.

sentences.zh: 陋漢、唐之小智，卑宋、元之淺圖。

translations.literal: We despise the small wisdom of Han and Tang and belittle the shallow designs of Song and Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: We despise the small wisdom of Han and Tang and belittle the shallow designs of Song and Yuan.

sentences.zh: 大兵所至，神龍助陣，天地應符。

translations.literal: Wherever the great army arrives, divine dragons assist the battle array and Heaven and Earth respond to the mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever the great army arrives, divine dragons assist the battle array and Heaven and Earth respond to the mandate.

sentences.zh: 汝段氏接武蒙氏，運已絕於元代，寬延至今。

translations.literal: Your Duan clan succeeded the Meng line; your fortune was already cut off under the Yuan and only prolonged until now.
translations.idiomatic: Your Duan clan succeeded the Meng line; your fortune was already cut off under the Yuan and only prolonged until now.

sentences.zh: 我師已殲梁王，報汝世仇，不降何待？」

translations.literal: Our army has already destroyed the Prince of Liang and avenged your hereditary enemy — why not submit? What are you waiting for?"
translations.idiomatic: Our army has already destroyed the Prince of Liang and avenged your hereditary enemy — why not submit? What are you waiting for?"

sentences.zh: 十五年，征南左將軍藍玉、右將軍沐英率師攻大理。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, the left southern expedition general Lan Yu and the right general Mu Ying led troops to attack Dali.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, the left southern expedition general Lan Yu and the right general Mu Ying led troops to attack Dali.

sentences.zh: 大理城倚點蒼山，西臨洱河為固。

translations.literal: Dali city leaned on Diancang Mountain and faced the Er River on the west for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Dali city leaned on Diancang Mountain and used the Er River on the west for its defense.

sentences.zh: 聞王師至，聚眾扼下關。

translations.literal: Hearing the royal army had arrived, they gathered troops to hold Xia Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing the imperial army had arrived, they gathered troops to hold Xia Pass.

sentences.zh: 下關者，南詔皮羅閣所築龍尾關也，號極險。

translations.literal: Xia Pass was Longwei Pass built by Piluoge of Nanzhao, called extremely perilous.
translations.idiomatic: Xia Pass was Longwei Pass, built by Piluoge of Nanzhao, and was called extremely perilous.

sentences.zh: 玉等至品甸，遣定遠侯王弼以兵由洱水東趨上關，為掎角勢，自率眾抵下關，造攻具。

translations.literal: When Yu and the others reached Pindian, they sent Marquis of Dingyuan Wang Bi with troops along the east of the Er River toward Shang Pass in a pincer formation, while he himself led the host to Xia Pass and prepared siege equipment.
translations.idiomatic: When Yu and the others reached Pindian, they sent the Marquis of Dingyuan Wang Bi with troops along the east of the Er River toward Shang Pass in a pincer formation, while Yu himself led the host to Xia Pass and prepared siege equipment.

sentences.zh: 遣都督胡海洋由石門間道夜渡河，繞出點蒼山後，攀木援崖而上，立旗幟。

translations.literal: He dispatched Commissioner Hu Haiyang by the Shimen bypath to cross the river at night, circle behind Diancang Mountain, climb by trees and ropes up the cliffs, and raise banners.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched Commissioner Hu Haiyang by the Shimen bypath to cross the river at night, circle behind Diancang Mountain, climb the cliffs by trees and ropes, and raise banners.

sentences.zh: 昧爽，軍抵下關者望見，皆踴躍讙噪，蠻眾驚亂。

translations.literal: At daybreak, those who reached Xia Pass saw them and all leaped and shouted in joy; the barbarian host was startled and thrown into disorder.
translations.idiomatic: At daybreak the troops at Xia Pass saw them and leaped and shouted in joy; the barbarian host was startled and thrown into disorder.

sentences.zh: 英身先士卒，策馬渡河，水沒馬腹，將士隨之，遂斬關入。

translations.literal: Ying himself led the assault, spurred his horse across the river until the water reached the horse's belly, and the soldiers followed; they then cut through the pass and entered.
translations.idiomatic: Ying led the assault himself, spurred his horse across the river until the water reached the horse's belly, and the soldiers followed; they then cut through the pass and entered.

sentences.zh: 蠻兵潰，拔其城，酋長段世就擒。

translations.literal: The barbarian troops collapsed; the city was taken and the chieftain Duan Shi was captured.
translations.idiomatic: The barbarian troops collapsed, the city was taken, and the chieftain Duan Shi was captured.

sentences.zh: 世與明皆段寶子也。

translations.literal: Shi and Ming were both sons of Duan Bao.
translations.idiomatic: Shi and Ming were both sons of Duan Bao.

sentences.zh: 至京師，帝傳諭曰：「爾父寶曾有降表，朕不忍廢。」

translations.literal: Reaching the capital, the Emperor transmitted instruction saying, "Your father Bao once presented a submission of surrender; I could not bear to abolish you."
translations.idiomatic: When they reached the capital, the Emperor transmitted instruction, saying, "Your father Bao once presented a memorial of surrender; I could not bear to abolish you."

sentences.zh: 賜長子名歸仁，授永昌衛鎮撫；

translations.literal: He granted the eldest son the name Guiren and appointed him Pacification Officer of Yongchang;
translations.idiomatic: He granted the eldest son the name Guiren and appointed him Pacification Officer of Yongchang;

sentences.zh: 次子名歸義，授雁門鎮撫。

translations.literal: the second son the name Guiyi, appointed Pacification Officer of Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: the second son the name Guiyi and appointed him Pacification Officer of Yanmen.

sentences.zh: 大理悉定，因改大理路為大理府，置衛，設指揮使司。

translations.literal: Dali was entirely pacified; Dali Circuit was changed to Dali Prefecture, a guard was established, and a regional military commission was set up.
translations.idiomatic: Dali was entirely pacified. Dali Circuit was changed to Dali Prefecture, a guard was established, and a regional military commission was set up.

sentences.zh: 臨安，古句町國。

translations.literal: Lin'an was the ancient state of Gouding.
translations.idiomatic: Lin'an was the ancient state of Gouding.

sentences.zh: 漢置縣。

translations.literal: Han established a county.
translations.idiomatic: The Han established a county there.

sentences.zh: 唐為羈縻牁州地。

translations.literal: Tang made it territory of the Jimi Ge Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it was territory of the Jimi Ge Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 天寶末，南詔蒙氏於此置通海郡。

translations.literal: At the end of Tianbao, the Meng clan of Nanzhao established Tonghai Commandery here.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Tianbao reign, the Meng clan of Nanzhao established Tonghai Commandery here.

sentences.zh: 元時內附，置阿僰部萬戶府。

translations.literal: In Yuan times it submitted and the Abo Ten-thousand-households Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuan times it submitted, and the Abo Ten-thousand-households Office was established.

sentences.zh: 至元中改臨安路，屬臨安、廣西、元江等處宣慰司。

translations.literal: In the Zhongyuan era it was changed to Lin'an Circuit, subordinate to the Lin'an, Guangxi, and Yuanjiang Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhongyuan era it was changed to Lin'an Circuit, subordinate to the Lin'an, Guangxi, and Yuanjiang Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 洪武十四年，征南將軍下雲南，遣宣德侯金朝興分道取臨安。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Hongwu, when the southern expedition general descended on Yunnan, he sent Marquis of Xuande Jin Chaoxing by separate routes to take Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Hongwu, when the southern expedition general descended on Yunnan, he sent the Marquis of Xuande Jin Chaoxing by separate routes to take Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 元右丞兀卜臺、元帥完者都及土官楊政降，改路為府，廢宣慰司，置臨安衛指揮使司。

translations.literal: Yuan Right Chancellor Wubutai, Marshal Wanzhedu, and native official Yang Zheng submitted; the circuit was changed to a prefecture, the pacification commission abolished, and the Lin'an Regional Military Commission established.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan Right Chancellor Wubutai, Marshal Wanzhedu, and native official Yang Zheng submitted. The circuit was changed to a prefecture, the pacification commission abolished, and the Lin'an Regional Military Commission established.

sentences.zh: 十七年以土官和寧為阿迷知州，弄甥為寧州知州，陸羨為蒙自知縣，普少為納婁茶甸副長官；

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the native officials He Ning as subprefect of Ami, Nong Sheng as subprefect of Ningzhou, Lu Xian as magistrate of Mengzi, and Pu Shao as deputy headman of Nalou Chadian;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year the native officials He Ning as subprefect of Ami, Nong Sheng as subprefect of Ningzhou, Lu Xian as magistrate of Mengzi, and Pu Shao as deputy headman of Nalou Chadian were appointed;

sentences.zh: 俱來朝貢，因給誥敕冠帶以命之。

translations.literal: all came to court with tribute, and patent letters, edicts, caps, and belts were granted to confirm them.
translations.idiomatic: all came to court with tribute, and patent letters, edicts, caps, and belts were granted to confirm them.

sentences.zh: 十八年，臨安府千戶納速丁等來朝，人賜米十石。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, thousand-household Nashuding of Lin'an Prefecture and others came to court; each person was granted ten piculs of rice.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, Thousand-household Nashuding of Lin'an Prefecture and others came to court; each person was granted ten piculs of rice.

sentences.zh: 永樂九年，溪處甸長官司副長官自恩來朝，貢馬及金銀器，賜賚如例。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Yongle, Deputy Headman Zi En of the Xichu native headman office came to court, presenting horses and gold and silver vessels; rewards were granted according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Yongle, Deputy Headman Zi En of the Xichu native headman office came to court, presenting horses and gold and silver vessels; rewards were granted according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 自恩因言：「本司歲納海<貝巴>七萬九千八百索，非土所產，乞準鈔銀為便。」

translations.literal: Zi En therefore said, "This office pays seventy-nine thousand eight hundred cords of sea cowries yearly, which are not produced locally; we beg permission to pay in paper money and silver instead."
translations.idiomatic: Zi En therefore said, "This office pays seventy-nine thousand eight hundred cords of sea cowries yearly, which are not produced locally; we beg permission to pay in paper money and silver instead."

sentences.zh: 戶部以洪武中定額，難準折輸。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue, citing the Hongwu quota, said conversion was difficult.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue, citing the Hongwu quota, said conversion was difficult.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「取有於無，適以厲民，況彼遠夷，尤當寬恤，其除之。」

translations.literal: The Emperor said, "Taking from where there is none only harms the people; how much more for those distant barbarians — they should especially be treated leniently; abolish it."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Taking from where there is none only harms the people; how much more for those distant barbarians — they should especially be treated leniently. Abolish it."

sentences.zh: 宣德五年，中官雲仙還自雲南，奏設東山口巡檢司，以故土官後普覺為巡檢。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xuande, the eunuch Yun Xian returning from Yunnan memorialized establishing the Dongshankou Inspection Office, with the former native official's descendant Hou Pujue as inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xuande, the eunuch Yun Xian, returning from Yunnan, memorialized establishing the Dongshankou Inspection Office, with the former native official's descendant Hou Pujue as inspector.

sentences.zh: 八年，虧容甸長官司奏：「河底自洪武中官置渡船，路通車裏、八百。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the Kuirong native headman office memorialized, "Since Hongwu the government placed ferry boats at Hedi; the road connects Cheli and Babai.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, the Kuirong native headman office memorialized, "Since the Hongwu reign the government placed ferry boats at Hedi; the road connects Cheli and Babai.

sentences.zh: 近年軍民有逃逸出境詐稱使者，迫令乘載，往往被害，又沿河時有劫盜出沒。

translations.literal: In recent years soldiers and civilians have fled across the border falsely claiming to be envoys, forcing people to carry them, and are often killed; moreover bandits along the river often appear and disappear.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years soldiers and civilians have fled across the border falsely claiming to be envoys, forcing people to carry them, and are often killed; moreover bandits along the river often appear and disappear.

sentences.zh: 乞置巡檢司，以故把事袁凱之子瑀為巡檢。」

translations.literal: We beg to establish an inspection office, with Yuan Kai's son Yu, former baishi, as inspector."
translations.idiomatic: We beg to establish an inspection office, with Yuan Kai's son Yu, former baishi, as inspector."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年復設寧州流官知州，掌州事，土知州祿氏專職巡捕。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiajing the regular subprefect of Ningzhou was re-established to manage prefectural affairs, while the Lu clan native subprefect was confined to patrol and arrest duties.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiajing the regular subprefect of Ningzhou was re-established to manage prefectural affairs, while the Lu clan native subprefect was confined to patrol and arrest duties.

sentences.zh: 寧州舊設流官，正德初，土官祿俸陰賄劉瑾罷之。

translations.literal: Ningzhou had formerly had a regular official; at the beginning of Zhengde the native official Lu Feng secretly bribed Liu Jin to abolish it.
translations.idiomatic: Ningzhou had formerly had a regular official; at the beginning of Zhengde the native official Lu Feng secretly bribed Liu Jin to abolish it.

sentences.zh: 遂交通彌勒州十八寨強賊為亂，為官軍捕誅，其子祿世爵復以罪論死。

translations.literal: He then joined with the strong bandits of the eighteen stockades of Mile Prefecture in rebellion, was captured and executed by government troops, and his son Lu Shijue was again sentenced to death for crime.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined with the strong bandits of the eighteen stockades of Mile Prefecture in rebellion, was captured and executed by government troops, and his son Lu Shijue was again sentenced to death for crime.

sentences.zh: 撫按請仍設流官，從之。

translations.literal: The grand coordinator and surveillance commissioner requested re-establishment of a regular official; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The grand coordinator and surveillance commissioner requested re-establishment of a regular official; it was approved.

sentences.zh: 初，臨安阿迷州土官普柱，洪武中為土知州。

translations.literal: At first, Pu Zhu, native subprefect of Ami in Lin'an, in Hongwu was native subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: At first, Pu Zhu, native subprefect of Ami in Lin'an, served as native subprefect in the Hongwu reign.

sentences.zh: 後設流，錄其後覺為東山巡檢，既而以他事廢。

translations.literal: Later a regular official was established; his descendant Jue was registered as Dongshan inspector, then abolished for other matters.
translations.idiomatic: Later a regular official was established; his descendant Jue was registered as Dongshan inspector, then abolished for other matters.

sentences.zh: 正德二年以廣西維摩、王弄山與阿迷接壤，盜出沒，仍令普覺後納繼前職。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengde, because Guangxi Weimo and Wangnong Mountain bordered Ami and bandits appeared, Pujue's descendant Na was again allowed to succeed to the former post.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhengde, because Guangxi Weimo and Wangnong Mountain bordered Ami and bandits appeared, Pujue's descendant Na was again allowed to succeed to the former post.

sentences.zh: 普維藩者，與寧州祿氏構兵，師殲焉。

translations.literal: Pu Weifan raised troops with the Lu clan of Ningzhou and the army was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Pu Weifan raised troops with the Lu clan of Ningzhou and the army was destroyed.

sentences.zh: 維藩子名聲，幼育於官，既長，有司俾繼父職。

translations.literal: Weifan's son Mingsheng was raised from childhood in the government office; when grown, the authorities had him succeed to his father's post.
translations.idiomatic: Weifan's son Mingsheng was raised from childhood in the government office; when grown, the authorities had him succeed to his father's post.

sentences.zh: 名聲收拾舊部，勇於攻戰，從討奢安有功，仍授土知州，漸驕恣。

translations.literal: Mingsheng gathered his old followers, was bold in attack, followed the campaign against She An with merit, was again granted native subprefect, and gradually grew arrogant.
translations.idiomatic: Mingsheng gathered his old followers, was bold in attack, served in the campaign against She An with merit, was again granted native subprefect, and gradually grew arrogant.

sentences.zh: 崇禎五年，御史趙洪範按部，名聲不出迎。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chongzhen, Censor Zhao Hongfan made his inspection rounds; Mingsheng did not come out to welcome him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Chongzhen, Censor Zhao Hongfan made his inspection rounds; Mingsheng did not come out to welcome him.

sentences.zh: 已，出戈甲旗幟列數里。

translations.literal: Afterward he displayed armor, weapons, banners, and flags lined for several li.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward he displayed armor, weapons, banners, and flags lined for several li.

sentences.zh: 洪範大怒，謀之巡撫王伉，請討，得旨。

translations.literal: Hongfan was greatly angered, consulted Grand Coordinator Wang Kang, requested a campaign, and obtained the edict.
translations.idiomatic: Hongfan was greatly angered, consulted Grand Coordinator Wang Kang, requested a campaign, and obtained the edict.

sentences.zh: 官軍進圍州城，名聲恐，使人約降，而陰以重賄求援於元謀土官吾必奎。

translations.literal: Government troops advanced to besiege the subprefectural city; Mingsheng was afraid, sent someone to arrange surrender, but secretly sent heavy bribes to seek aid from Wu Bikui, native official of Yuanmou.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops advanced to besiege the subprefectural city. Mingsheng was afraid, sent someone to arrange surrender, but secretly sent heavy bribes to seek aid from Wu Bikui, native official of Yuanmou.

sentences.zh: 時官軍已調必奎隨征，必奎與名聲戰，兵始合，佯敗走。

translations.literal: At the time government troops had already summoned Bikui to join the campaign; Bikui fought with Mingsheng, and when the armies had just joined battle he pretended defeat and fled.
translations.idiomatic: At the time government troops had already summoned Bikui to join the campaign. Bikui fought with Mingsheng, and when the armies had just joined battle he pretended defeat and fled.

sentences.zh: 官軍望見，遂大潰，布政使周士昌戰死。

translations.literal: The government troops saw this and were routed in great disorder; Administrative Commissioner Zhou Shichang died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: The government troops saw this and were routed in great disorder; Administrative Commissioner Zhou Shichang died in battle.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以起釁罪伉，逮治，而名聲就撫。

translations.literal: The court blamed Kang for provoking the incident and had him arrested for punishment, while Mingsheng was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The court blamed Kang for provoking the incident and had him arrested for punishment, while Mingsheng was pacified.

sentences.zh: 然驕恣益甚，當事者頗以為患。

translations.literal: Yet he grew ever more arrogant; those in charge were quite troubled by him.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he grew ever more arrogant; those in charge were quite troubled by him.

sentences.zh: 已而廣西知府張繼孟道出阿迷，以計毒殺之。

translations.literal: Later Guangxi Prefect Zhang Jimeng passed through Ami on his route and poisoned him by stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: Later Guangxi Prefect Zhang Jimeng passed through Ami on his route and poisoned him by stratagem.

sentences.zh: 必奎聞名聲死，遂反，連陷武定、祿豐、楚雄諸城。

translations.literal: When Bikui heard Mingsheng was dead, he rebelled and in succession captured Wuding, Lufeng, Chuxiong, and other cities.
translations.idiomatic: When Bikui heard Mingsheng was dead, he rebelled and in succession captured Wuding, Lufeng, Chuxiong, and other cities.

sentences.zh: 寧州土官祿永命、石屏州土目龍在田，俱與必奎、名聲從征著名，至是，黔國公沐天波檄之統兵，合剿擒必奎。

translations.literal: The native official Lu Yongming of Ningzhou and the native officer Long Zaitian of Shiping Prefecture had both been famous for following Bikui and Mingsheng on campaign; now the Duke of Qian Mu Tianbo summoned them to command troops, combined to suppress and capture Bikui.
translations.idiomatic: The native official Lu Yongming of Ningzhou and the native officer Long Zaitian of Shiping Prefecture had both been famous for following Bikui and Mingsheng on campaign. Now the Duke of Qian Mu Tianbo summoned them to command troops and combined forces to suppress and capture Bikui.

sentences.zh: 名聲妻萬氏，本江西寄籍女，淫而狡。

translations.literal: Mingsheng's wife Lady Wan was originally a woman of Jiangxi registered residence, licentious and cunning.
translations.idiomatic: Mingsheng's wife Lady Wan was originally a woman of Jiangxi registered residence, licentious and cunning.

sentences.zh: 名聲死後，改嫁王弄山副長官沙源之子定洲。

translations.literal: After Mingsheng died, she remarried Sha Dingzhou, son of Sha Yuan, deputy headman of Wangnong Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: After Mingsheng died, she remarried Sha Dingzhou, son of Sha Yuan, deputy headman of Wangnong Mountain.

sentences.zh: 名聲有子曰服遠，與萬氏分寨居，定洲誘殺服遠，並其地。

translations.literal: Mingsheng had a son Fuyuan who lived in a separate stockade with Lady Wan; Dingzhou lured and killed Fuyuan and annexed his territory.
translations.idiomatic: Mingsheng had a son Fuyuan who lived in a separate stockade with Lady Wan; Dingzhou lured and killed Fuyuan and annexed his territory.

sentences.zh: 天波檄定洲取必奎，定洲不欲行，遂反，詳前傳。

translations.literal: Tianbo summoned Dingzhou to take Bikui; Dingzhou did not wish to go and rebelled, as detailed in the previous biography.
translations.idiomatic: Tianbo summoned Dingzhou to take Bikui; Dingzhou did not wish to go and rebelled, as detailed in the previous biography.

sentences.zh: 臨安領州四，縣四。

translations.literal: Lin'an oversaw four subprefectures and four counties.
translations.idiomatic: Lin'an oversaw four subprefectures and four counties.

sentences.zh: 其長官司有九，曰納樓茶甸，曰教化三部，曰溪處甸，曰左能寨，曰王弄山，曰虧容甸，曰思陀甸，曰落恐甸，曰安南，其地皆在郡東南。

translations.literal: Its native headman offices numbered nine: Nalou Chadian, Jiaohua Three Departments, Xichu, Zuoneng Stockade, Wangnong Mountain, Kuirong, Situo, Luokong, and Annan — all their lands lay southeast of the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Its native headman offices numbered nine: Nalou Chadian, Jiaohua Three Departments, Xichu, Zuoneng Stockade, Wangnong Mountain, Kuirong, Situo, Luokong, and Annan — all their lands lay southeast of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 西平侯征安南，取道於此。

translations.literal: When the Marquis of Xiping campaigned against Annan, he took the route through here.
translations.idiomatic: When the Marquis of Xiping campaigned against Annan, he took the route through here.

sentences.zh: 蓮花灘之外即交荒外，而臨安無南面之虞者，以諸甸為之備也。

translations.literal: Beyond Lotus Beach lies the outer wilds of Jiaozhi; that Lin'an had no worry on the south face was because the various districts served as its defense.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond Lotus Beach lies the outer wilds of Jiaozhi; that Lin'an had no worry on the south face was because the various districts served as its defense.

sentences.zh: 但地多瘴，流官不欲入，諸長官亦不請代襲，自相冠帶，日尋幹戈。

translations.literal: But the land was mostly malarial; regular officials did not wish to enter, and the headmen also did not request succession — they crowned themselves and daily sought one another in arms.
translations.idiomatic: But the land was mostly malarial; regular officials did not wish to enter, and the headmen also did not request succession — they crowned themselves and daily sought one another in arms.

sentences.zh: 納樓部內有礦場三，曰中場、鵝黃、摩訶。

translations.literal: Within the Nalou department were three mining sites: called Zhongchang, Ehuang, and Mohe.
translations.idiomatic: Within the Nalou department were three mining sites: called Zhongchang, Ehuang, and Mohe.

sentences.zh: 封閉已久，亡命多竊取之。

translations.literal: Long sealed, many fugitives secretly mined them.
translations.idiomatic: They had long been sealed, and many fugitives secretly mined them.

sentences.zh: 其安南長官司，本阿僰蠻所居，舊名褒古，後名舍資。

translations.literal: The Annan native headman office was originally where the Abo barbarians dwelt, formerly called Baogu, later called Shezi.
translations.idiomatic: The Annan native headman office was originally where the Abo barbarians dwelt, formerly called Baogu, later called Shezi.

sentences.zh: 元為舍資千戶所。

translations.literal: Under Yuan it was the Shezi Thousand-household Office.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was the Shezi Thousand-household Office.

sentences.zh: 以地近交址，改安南，屬臨安路。

translations.literal: Because the land was near Jiaozhi, it was changed to Annan and made subordinate to Lin'an Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Because the land was near Jiaozhi, it was changed to Annan and made subordinate to Lin'an Circuit.

sentences.zh: 正德八年，蒙自土舍祿祥爭襲父職，鴆殺其嫡兄祿仁，安南長官司土舍那代助之以兵，遂稱亂，守臣討平之。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhengde, Lu Xiang, native clerk of Mengzi, fought over succeeding to his father's post, poisoned his elder brother Lu Ren, and the native clerk Na of the Annan headman office aided him with troops; they then styled it rebellion and defending officials pacified it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Zhengde, Lu Xiang, native clerk of Mengzi, fought over succeeding to his father's post, poisoned his elder brother Lu Ren, and the native clerk Na of the Annan headman office aided him with troops; they then styled it rebellion and defending officials pacified it.

sentences.zh: 事聞，命革蒙自土官，改長官司為新安守禦千戶所，調臨安衛中所官軍戍之。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, orders were given to abolish the Mengzi native official, change the headman office to the Xin'an Defense Thousand-household Office, and transfer garrison troops from the central battalion of Lin'an Guard.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was reported, orders were given to abolish the Mengzi native official, change the headman office to the Xin'an Defense Thousand-household Office, and transfer garrison troops from the central battalion of Lin'an Guard.

sentences.zh: 宣德五年命故土知府高政女襲同知。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xuande, orders were given for the former native prefect Gao Zheng's daughter to succeed as vice prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Xuande, orders were given for the former native prefect Gao Zheng's daughter to succeed as vice prefect.

sentences.zh: 政初為同知，永樂中來朝，時仁宗監國，嘉其勤誠，升知府，子孫仍襲同知。

translations.literal: Zheng had first been vice prefect; in Yongle he came to court; at the time the Heir Apparent supervised the realm and praised his diligence and sincerity, promoting him to prefect; descendants still succeeded as vice prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng had first been vice prefect; in Yongle he came to court; at the time the Heir Apparent supervised the realm and praised his diligence and sincerity, promoting him to prefect; descendants still succeeded as vice prefect.

sentences.zh: 政卒，無子，妻襲。

translations.literal: When Zheng died without a son, his wife succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Zheng died without a son, his wife succeeded.

sentences.zh: 又卒，其女奏乞襲知府。

translations.literal: When she too died, his daughter memorialized begging to succeed as prefect.
translations.idiomatic: When she too died, his daughter memorialized begging to succeed as prefect.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「皇考有成命。」

translations.literal: The Emperor said, "The late Emperor had a settled command."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "The late Emperor had a settled command."

sentences.zh: 令襲同知。

translations.literal: He ordered her to succeed as vice prefect.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered her to succeed as vice prefect.

sentences.zh: 八年升南安州瑯井土巡檢李保為州判官；

translations.literal: In the eighth year Li Bao, native inspector of Langjing in Nan'an Subprefecture, was promoted to assistant prefect;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year Li Bao, native inspector of Langjing in Nan'an Subprefecture, was promoted to assistant prefect;

sentences.zh: 以鄉老言：「本州俱羅舞、和泥、烏蠻雜類，稟性頑獷，以無土官管束，多致流移，差役賦稅，俱難理辦。

translations.literal: Based on the village elders' words: "In this prefecture there are mixed Jurawu, Heni, and Wuman peoples; their innate nature is stubborn and fierce. Because there is no native official to keep them in order, many have been driven to disperse and flee; corvée duties and tax levies are all difficult to manage and collect.
translations.idiomatic: Citing the village elders, the report stated that the prefecture was home to Jurawu, Heni, Wuman, and other mixed groups whose temperaments ran stubborn and wild. With no native official to restrain them, many people had drifted away, and both corvée labor and tax collection had become nearly impossible.

sentences.zh: 眾嘗推保署州事，撫綏得宜，民皆向服，流移復歸，乞授本州土官。」

translations.literal: The people had repeatedly recommended Bao to administer the prefectural affairs; his comforting governance was appropriate, the people all turned and submitted, those who had migrated returned, and they begged that he be granted the native official post of this prefecture."]
translations.idiomatic: The people had repeatedly chosen Bao to manage the prefecture. He governed them well, won their loyalty, and brought back those who had fled. They petitioned that he be appointed native official of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 吏部言：「南安舊無土官，難從其請。」

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel reported: "Nan'an has never had a native official before; it is difficult to accede to their request."]
translations.idiomatic: Closing the elders' petition, the Ministry of Personnel replied that Nan'an had never had a native official and that the request could not easily be granted.

sentences.zh: 帝以為治在順民情，從之。

translations.literal: The Emperor held that good governance lies in following the people's wishes, and consented.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, however, held that sound rule meant heeding the people's wishes, and he approved the request.

sentences.zh: 九年，黔國公沐晟等奏：「楚雄所屬黑石江及泥坎村銀場，軍民盜礦，千百為群，執兵攘奪。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, the Prince of Qian Mu Sheng and others memorialized: "At the silver mines of Heishi River and Nikeng Village under Chuxiong, soldiers and civilians illicitly mine ore; they gather in groups of hundreds and thousands, take up arms, and seize the mines by force.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, Prince of Qian Mu Sheng and others reported that at the Heishi River and Nikeng Village silver mines under Chuxiong, soldiers and civilians were mining illegally in bands of hundreds and thousands, armed and fighting one another for control.

sentences.zh: 楚雄縣賊首者些糾合武定賊者惟等，劫掠軍民，殺巡檢張禎。

translations.literal: Zhexie, bandit chief of Chuxiong County, joined with Zhewei and other bandits of Wuding to plunder soldiers and civilians and killed Inspector Zhang Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: Zhexie, a bandit leader in Chuxiong County, joined forces with Zhewei and other outlaws from Wuding to raid soldiers and civilians, killing Inspector Zhang Zhen.

sentences.zh: 又定邊縣阿苴裏諸處強賊，聚眾抄掠景東等衛。

translations.literal: Moreover, powerful bandits at Ajuli and other places in Dingbian County gathered crowds to raid and plunder Jingdong Guard and other guards.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile, powerful bandits around Ajuli in Dingbian County had gathered in force to raid Jingdong Guard and neighboring garrisons.

sentences.zh: 大理、蒙化、楚雄、姚州皆有盜出沒。」

translations.literal: Dali, Menghua, Chuxiong, and Yaozhou all had bandits appearing and disappearing."]
translations.idiomatic: Bandits were appearing throughout Dali, Menghua, Chuxiong, and Yaozhou.

sentences.zh: 帝敕責晟等，期以三年，討靖諸為亂者。

translations.literal: The Emperor issued an edict rebuking Sheng and the others, setting a deadline of three years to suppress and pacify all who were causing disorder.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor rebuked Sheng and his colleagues by edict and gave them three years to suppress every rebel in the region.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖四十三年，楚雄叛蠻阿方等兵起，先攻易門所，流劫習峨、昆陽、新化各州縣，僭稱王，約土官王一心、王行道為援。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year of Jiajing, the rebellious barbarians Afang and others of Chuxiong raised troops; they first attacked Yimen Guard, then swept through and plundered Xie'e, Kunyang, Xinhua, and other prefectures and counties; they presumptuously styled themselves kings and arranged for native officials Wang Yixin and Wang Xingdao to aid them.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-third year of Jiajing, Afang and other Chuxiong rebels took up arms. They first attacked Yimen Guard, then raided Xie'e, Kunyang, Xinhua, and neighboring districts, proclaimed themselves kings, and sought support from native officials Wang Yixin and Wang Xingdao.

sentences.zh: 一心後悔，詣軍門請討賊自效。

translations.literal: Yixin afterward repented, went to the military headquarters, and requested to campaign against the bandits to prove his loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Yixin later regretted his involvement, went to the army headquarters, and offered to hunt down the rebels to redeem himself.

sentences.zh: 巡撫呂光洵許之，招降數百人。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Lu Guangxun assented and received the surrender of several hundred men.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Lu Guangxun agreed, and several hundred rebels surrendered.

sentences.zh: 官軍分道進，擒獲賊黨。

translations.literal: Government troops advanced by separate routes and captured bandit partisans.
translations.idiomatic: Government forces advanced along several routes and captured rebel bands.

sentences.zh: 乘勝攻大、小木址二寨，克之，斬阿方首，余賊悉平。

translations.literal: Pressing the victory, they attacked the two stockades of Da and Xiao Muzhi, took them, beheaded Afang, and completely pacified the remaining bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Following up their victory, they stormed the stockades at Da and Xiao Muzhi, took both, beheaded Afang, and wiped out the remaining rebels.

sentences.zh: 澄江，唐為南寧、昆二州地。

translations.literal: Chengjiang was in the Tang the territory of Nanning and Kun Prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Chengjiang had been the territory of Nanning and Kun Prefectures under the Tang.

sentences.zh: 天寶末，沒於蠻，號羅伽甸。

translations.literal: At the end of the Tianbao era, it was lost to the barbarians and was called the Luojia district.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Tianbao reign, it fell to tribal peoples and became known as the Luojia district.

sentences.zh: 宋時，大理段氏號羅伽部。

translations.literal: In Song times, the Duan clan of Dali called it the Luojia department.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song, the Duan clan of Dali ruled it as the Luojia department.

sentences.zh: 元置羅伽萬戶府。

translations.literal: Yuan established the Luojia Ten-thousand-households Office.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan established the Luojia Ten-thousand-households Office there.

sentences.zh: 至元中，改澄江路。

translations.literal: In the Zhiyuan period, it was changed to Chengjiang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhiyuan era, it was reorganized as Chengjiang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年，雲南平，澄江歸附，改澄江府。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu, Yunnan was pacified; Chengjiang submitted and was changed to Chengjiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu, after Yunnan was pacified, Chengjiang submitted and was made Chengjiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 地居滇省之中，山川明秀，蠶衣耕食，民安於業。

translations.literal: The land lies in the center of Yunnan Province; its mountains and rivers are bright and fair; the people dress in silk and live by farming, and the populace is secure in their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: Situated at the heart of Yunnan, the region has fine mountains and rivers. The people raise silkworms, farm their fields, and live securely in their trades.

sentences.zh: 近郡之羅羅，性雖頑狠，然恭敬上官。

translations.literal: The Luoluo of neighboring prefectures, though their nature is stubborn and fierce, are nevertheless respectful toward their superiors.
translations.idiomatic: The Luoluo in neighboring districts could be fierce by nature, yet they were deferential toward the authorities.

sentences.zh: 官至，爭迎到家，刲羊擊豕，罄所有以供之，婦女皆出羅拜，故於諸府獨號安靜雲。

translations.literal: When officials arrived, they vied to welcome them into their homes, slaughtered sheep and pigs, exhausted all they possessed to supply them, and women all came out to bow in greeting; therefore among all prefectures it alone was called Tranquil Clouds.
translations.idiomatic: When officials arrived, families competed to welcome them home, slaughtered sheep and pigs, and offered everything they had. The women came out to bow in greeting. For this reason it alone among the prefectures was nicknamed Tranquil Clouds.

sentences.zh: 景東，古柘南也，漢尚未有其地。

translations.literal: Jingdong was ancient Zhenan; in Han times this land did not yet exist [under Chinese administration].
translations.idiomatic: Jingdong was ancient Zhenan, a region not yet under Han control.

sentences.zh: 唐南詔蒙氏始置銀生府，後為金齒白蠻所據。

translations.literal: In Tang, the Meng clan of Nanzhao first established Yinsheng Prefecture; afterward it was seized by the Jinchí Bai barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang, the Meng clan of Nanzhao first established Yinsheng Prefecture there, but it was later taken by the Jinchí Bai peoples.

sentences.zh: 元中統三年討平之，以所部隸威楚萬戶。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhongtong of Yuan it was suppressed and pacified, and its territory was placed under Weichu Ten-thousand-households.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhongtong under the Yuan, the region was pacified by force and placed under Weichu Ten-thousand-households.

sentences.zh: 至元中，置開南州。

translations.literal: In the Zhiyuan period, Kainan Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhiyuan era, Kainan Prefecture was established.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年平雲南，景東先歸附。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu, when Yunnan was pacified, Jingdong was the first to submit.
translations.idiomatic: When Yunnan was pacified in the fifteenth year of Hongwu, Jingdong was among the first to submit.

sentences.zh: 土官俄陶獻馬百六十匹、銀三千一百兩、馴象二。

translations.literal: The native official E Tao presented one hundred sixty horses, three thousand one hundred taels of silver, and two tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: Native official E Tao presented one hundred sixty horses, three thousand one hundred taels of silver, and two trained elephants.

sentences.zh: 詔置景東府，以俄陶知府事，賜以文綺襲衣。

translations.literal: An edict established Jingdong Prefecture, appointed E Tao to administer the prefecture, and bestowed upon him patterned silks and ceremonial robes.
translations.idiomatic: The court established Jingdong Prefecture, appointed E Tao prefect, and granted him patterned silks and ceremonial robes.

sentences.zh: 十八年，百夷思倫發叛，率眾十余萬攻景東之北吉寨。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, the Baiyi leader Si Lunfa rebelled, leading a force of more than one hundred thousand to attack Beiji Stockade in Jingdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, the Baiyi leader Si Lunfa rebelled and led more than one hundred thousand men against Beiji Stockade in Jingdong.

sentences.zh: 俄陶率眾禦之，為所敗，率其民千余家避於大理府之白崖川。

translations.literal: E Tao led the masses to resist them but was defeated; he led more than one thousand households of his people to take refuge at Baiyanchuan in Dali Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: E Tao led his people out to resist but was defeated, then withdrew with more than one thousand households to Baiyanchuan in Dali Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 事聞，帝嘉其忠，遣通政司經歷楊大用賫白金文綺賜之。
