translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the Emperor praised his loyalty and dispatched Yang Dayong, secretary of the Office of Transmission, bearing white silver and patterned silks to bestow upon him.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the court, the Emperor praised his loyalty and sent Yang Dayong of the Office of Transmission with silver and patterned silks as a reward.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，沐英討平思倫發，復景東地，因奏景東百夷要沖，宜置衛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Mu Ying suppressed and pacified Si Lunfa, recovered Jingdong territory, and thereupon memorialized that Jingdong was a vital pass among the Baiyi and that a guard should be established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, Mu Ying defeated Si Lunfa and recovered Jingdong. He then memorialized that Jingdong was a strategic choke point among the Baiyi peoples and that a guard should be established there.

sentences.zh: 以錦衣衛僉事胡常守之，俄陶仍舊職。

translations.literal: Hu Chang, assistant commissioner of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, was appointed to defend it, while E Tao retained his former office.
translations.idiomatic: Hu Chang, an assistant commissioner of the Embroidered Uniform Guard, was placed in command, while E Tao kept his former post.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，帝以景東為雲南要害，且多腴田，調白崖川軍士屯守。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, the Emperor, because Jingdong was a strategic point of Yunnan and had abundant fertile fields, transferred soldiers from Baiyanchuan to garrison and cultivate the land.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, deeming Jingdong a strategic stronghold of Yunnan with rich farmland, the Emperor transferred troops from Baiyanchuan to garrison and farm the area.

sentences.zh: 二十六年命洱海衛指揮同知賴鎮守景東，從沐春請也。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he ordered Lai, vice commander of Erhai Guard, to defend Jingdong, following a request from Mu Chun.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, at Mu Chun's request, the Emperor ordered Lai, vice commander of Erhai Guard, to take charge of Jingdong.

sentences.zh: 宣德五年置孟緬長官司。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xuande, the Mengmian Native Official District was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Mengmian Native Official District was established in the fifth year of Xuande.

sentences.zh: 時景東奏所轄孟緬、孟梳，地方遐遠，屢被外寇侵擾。

translations.literal: At that time Jingdong memorialized that the Mengmian and Mengshu districts under its jurisdiction were remote in location and had repeatedly suffered invasion and harassment by outside raiders.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, Jingdong reported that its distant districts of Mengmian and Mengshu had repeatedly been raided by outside enemies.

sentences.zh: 乞並孟梳於孟緬，設長官司，授把事姜嵩為長官，以隸景東，歲增貢銀五十兩。

translations.literal: It begged to merge Mengshu into Mengmian, establish a native official district, appoint the bashi Jiang Song as district chief, place it under Jingdong, and increase the annual tribute by fifty taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: It requested that Mengshu be merged into Mengmian as a native official district, with bashi Jiang Song appointed chief under Jingdong's jurisdiction, and that the annual tribute be raised by fifty taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 六年，大侯土知州刀奉漢侵據孟緬地，敕黔國公沐晟遣官撫諭。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Dao Fenghan, native prefect of Dahou, encroached upon and seized Mengmian territory; an edict ordered Prince of Qian Mu Sheng to dispatch officials to soothe and instruct him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Dao Fenghan, native prefect of Dahou, seized Mengmian territory. The Emperor ordered Prince of Qian Mu Sheng to send officials to negotiate with him.

sentences.zh: 正統中，思任發叛，官軍征麓川，知府陶瓚從征有功，進階大中大夫。

translations.literal: In the Zhengtong period, Si Renfa rebelled; when government troops campaigned against Luchuan, Prefect Tao Zan followed the expedition and achieved merit, and was promoted in rank to Grand Master of Palace Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhengtong reign, when Si Renfa rebelled and government forces marched on Luchuan, Prefect Tao Zan served with distinction and was promoted to Grand Master of Palace Attendance.

sentences.zh: 弘治十五年正月，景東衛雲霧黑暗，晝夜不別者凡七日，巡撫陳金以聞。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifteenth year of Hongzhi, at Jingdong Guard dark clouds and fog made day and night indistinguishable for seven days altogether; Grand Coordinator Chen Jin reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifteenth year of Hongzhi, Jingdong Guard was shrouded in darkness for seven days, day and night indistinguishable. Grand Coordinator Chen Jin reported the omen to the court.

sentences.zh: 命廷臣議考察，以謝天變。

translations.literal: The court ordered the ministers to deliberate on examinations and dismissals, so as to respond to Heaven's warning.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered its ministers to conduct official reviews in response to this heavenly portent.

sentences.zh: 南京刑部、都察院承旨，考黜文武官千二百員。

translations.literal: The Nanjing Ministry of Justice and Censorate received the order and examined and dismissed one thousand two hundred civil and military officials.
translations.idiomatic: Acting on the order, the Nanjing Ministry of Justice and Censorate reviewed and dismissed twelve hundred civil and military officials.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖中，者東甸稱亂，劫景東府印去。

translations.literal: In the Jiajing period, Zhedongdian raised disorder and seized the seal of Jingdong Prefecture and carried it off.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiajing reign, Zhedongdian rebelled and stole the seal of Jingdong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 土舍陶金追斬其頭目，奪印歸。

translations.literal: The tushe Tao Jin pursued them, beheaded their leader, recovered the seal, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Tushe Tao Jin pursued the rebels, killed their leader, recovered the seal, and brought it back.

sentences.zh: 景東部皆僰種，性淳樸，習弩射，以象戰。

translations.literal: The people of Jingdong are all of the Bo tribe; their nature is simple and honest; they are skilled in crossbow shooting and fight with elephants.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Jingdong are Bo tribesmen—plain and honest by nature, skilled with crossbows, and accustomed to fighting with war elephants.

sentences.zh: 歷討鐵索、米魯、那鑒、安銓、鳳繼祖諸役，皆調其兵及戰象。

translations.literal: In successive campaigns against the Tiesuo, Milu, Najian, An Quan, and Feng Jizu rebellions, their troops and war elephants were all mobilized.
translations.idiomatic: In the campaigns against the Tiesuo, Milu, Najian, An Quan, and Feng Jizu rebellions, their soldiers and war elephants were repeatedly called up.

sentences.zh: 天啟六年，貴州水西安邦彥反，率眾二十萬入滇境，至馬龍後山，去會城十五里。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tianqi, An Bangyan of Shuixi in Guizhou rebelled, leading a force of two hundred thousand into Yunnan territory, reaching Malong Rear Mountain, fifteen li from the provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Tianqi, An Bangyan of Shuixi, Guizhou, rebelled and led two hundred thousand men into Yunnan, reaching Malong Rear Mountain just fifteen li from the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 總兵官調景東土舍陶明卿率兵伏路左。

translations.literal: The regional commander mobilized the Jingdong tushe Tao Mingqing to lead troops and lie in ambush on the left of the road.
translations.idiomatic: The regional commander ordered Jingdong tushe Tao Mingqing to lead troops in ambush on the left flank of the road.

sentences.zh: 賊分道並至，官兵禦之，賊拒戰，勢甚銳。

translations.literal: The bandits arrived by separate routes together; government troops resisted them; the bandits fought back, and their momentum was very sharp.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels advanced along several routes at once. Government troops met them, but the rebels fought back with great force.

sentences.zh: 明卿乃以象陣從左翼沖出橫擊，賊潰，追奔十餘里。

translations.literal: Mingqing then led an elephant formation to burst out from the left wing and strike across; the bandits collapsed, and the pursuit ran more than ten li.
translations.idiomatic: Mingqing then charged from the left with his elephant formation and struck the enemy flank. The rebels broke and were pursued for more than ten li.

sentences.zh: 巡撫上功，推明卿第一。

translations.literal: The grand coordinator submitted a report of merit and ranked Mingqing first.
translations.idiomatic: The grand coordinator reported the victory and ranked Mingqing first in merit.

sentences.zh: 景東每調兵二千，必自效千余，餉士之費，未嘗仰給公家，土司中最稱恭順。

translations.literal: Whenever Jingdong was mobilized for two thousand troops, it always supplied more than one thousand of its own; the cost of provisioning the soldiers was never drawn from public funds—among tribal headmen it was most called respectful and obedient.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever two thousand troops were levied from Jingdong, it always furnished more than a thousand of its own men and never relied on the state for rations. Among the tribal headmen it was regarded as the most loyal and compliant.

sentences.zh: 其府治東有邦泰山，頗險峻，土官陶姓所世居也。

translations.literal: East of its prefectural seat is Mount Bangtai, quite steep and perilous, where the Tao clan of native officials has dwelt for generations.
translations.idiomatic: East of the prefectural seat stands steep and rugged Mount Bangtai, the ancestral home of the Tao clan of native officials.

sentences.zh: 廣南，宋時名特磨道。

translations.literal: Guangnan was in Song times called the Temo Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Guangnan was known in Song times as the Temo Circuit.

sentences.zh: 土酋儂姓，智高之裔也。

translations.literal: The native chieftains were of the Nong surname, descendants of Zhigao.
translations.idiomatic: The native chieftains belonged to the Nong clan, descendants of Zhigao.

sentences.zh: 元至元間，立廣南西路宣撫司。

translations.literal: Between the Zhiyuan years of Yuan, the Guangnan West Circuit Pacification Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhiyuan era of the Yuan, the Guangnan West Circuit Pacification Commission was established.

sentences.zh: 初領路城等五州，後惟領安寧、富二州。

translations.literal: At first it governed five prefectures including Lucheng; afterward it governed only the two prefectures of Anning and Fu.
translations.idiomatic: It initially governed five prefectures including Lucheng, but later retained only Anning and Fu.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年歸附，改廣南府，以土官儂郎金為同知。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu it submitted; it was changed to Guangnan Prefecture, and the native official Nong Langjin was appointed vice prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu it submitted and was made Guangnan Prefecture, with native official Nong Langjin appointed vice prefect.

sentences.zh: 十八年，郎金來朝，賜錦綺鈔錠。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, Langjin came to court and was bestowed brocades, patterned silks, and paper money ingots.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, Langjin came to court and received brocades, patterned silks, and paper money ingots.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，都指揮同知王俊奉命率雲南後衛官軍至廣南，築城建衛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, Vice Commander-in-chief Wang Jun, receiving orders, led the troops of Yunnan Rear Guard to Guangnan, built a city, and established a guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year, Vice Commander-in-chief Wang Jun led troops from Yunnan Rear Guard to Guangnan, where he built a walled city and established a garrison.

sentences.zh: 郎金父貞佑不自安，結眾據山寨拒守。

translations.literal: Langjin's father Zhenyou felt ill at ease, gathered a crowd, seized a mountain stockade, and resisted in defense.
translations.idiomatic: Langjin's father Zhenyou, feeling insecure, gathered followers, seized a mountain stockade, and prepared to resist.

sentences.zh: 俊遣人招之，不服，時伏草莽中劫掠，覘官軍進退。

translations.literal: Jun sent men to summon him, but he would not submit; he often lay hidden in the grass and thickets to plunder and watched the advance and retreat of government troops.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun sent envoys to summon him, but he refused to submit. He hid in the brush to raid and spy on the movements of government troops.

sentences.zh: 俊乃遣指揮歐慶等分兵攻各寨，自將取貞佑；

translations.literal: Jun then dispatched Commanders Ou Qing and others to divide troops and attack the various stockades, while he personally led the force to capture Zhenyou;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jun then sent Commanders Ou Qing and others to attack the stockades in separate columns while he personally led the main force against Zhenyou;

sentences.zh: 又以兵扼間道，絕其救援。

translations.literal: he also placed troops to block the bypaths and cut off their relief.
translations.idiomatic: and posted troops on the side paths to cut off any relief.

sentences.zh: 諸寨悉破，眾潰，貞佑窮促就擒，械送京師。

translations.literal: All the stockades were completely broken; the masses collapsed; Zhenyou, driven to extremity, was captured, placed in fetters, and sent to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: All the stockades fell, the rebels scattered, and Zhenyou, cornered, was captured and sent to the capital in chains.

sentences.zh: 降郎金為府通判。

translations.literal: Langjin was demoted to prefectural assistant prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Langjin was demoted to assistant prefect of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 永樂六年，富州土知州沈弦經入貢，值仁孝皇后喪，弦經奉香幣致祭。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yongle, Shen Xianjing, native prefect of Fuzhou, came to pay tribute; it happened to coincide with the mourning for Empress Renxiao, and Xianjing presented incense and silks in offering.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Yongle, Shen Xianjing, native prefect of Fuzhou, came to pay tribute during the mourning period for Empress Renxiao and offered incense and silks in memorial rites.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年，土官儂郎舉來朝，貢馬。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuande, the native official Nong Langju came to court and presented horses as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuande, native official Nong Langju came to court and presented horses in tribute.

sentences.zh: 正統六年，廣南賊阿羅、阿思等劫掠，命總兵官沐昂等招撫之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhengtong, the Guangnan bandits Aluo, Asi, and others plundered; the regional commander Mu Ang and others were ordered to summon and soothe them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Zhengtong, the Guangnan bandits Aluo, Asi, and others raided the region. Regional commander Mu Ang and others were ordered to negotiate with them.

sentences.zh: 時富州土官沈政與郎舉互訐糾眾侵地，帝命昂等勘處。

translations.literal: At that time the Fuzhou native official Shen Zheng and Langju mutually accused one another and gathered crowds to encroach on territory; the Emperor ordered Ang and others to investigate and settle the matter.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, Fuzhou native official Shen Zheng and Langju were accusing each other and raising followers to seize one another's land. The Emperor ordered Ang and others to investigate.

sentences.zh: 七年，昂奏二人叛逆無實跡，因有隙相妄奏。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Ang memorialized that the two men's rebellion had no factual evidence and that because of enmity they had falsely accused each other.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Ang reported that neither man had actually rebelled and that their mutual accusations stemmed from personal enmity.

sentences.zh: 兵部請治政等罪，帝以蠻人宥之。

translations.literal: The Ministry of War requested that Zheng and the others be punished for their crimes; the Emperor pardoned them as barbarian peoples.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of War asked that Zheng and the others be punished, but the Emperor pardoned them as tribal subjects.

sentences.zh: 政、舉相仇殺已十余年，時方征麓川，憚兵威不敢動。

translations.literal: Zheng and Langju had been mutual enemies in killing for more than ten years; at that time the campaign against Luchuan was underway, and they feared military might and dared not act.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng and Langju had been feuding and killing one another for more than ten years, but with the Luchuan campaign underway they feared the army's power and held back.

sentences.zh: 未幾，郎舉以從征功升同知，死無嗣，四門舍目共推儂文舉署事，屢立戰功。

translations.literal: Before long, Langju was promoted to vice prefect for merit in following the campaign; he died without heirs, and the four-gate shemu jointly recommended Nong Wenju to administer affairs; he repeatedly achieved military merit.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Langju was promoted to vice prefect for his service in the campaign. He died without heirs, and the four-gate shemu chose Nong Wenju to administer affairs. Wenju distinguished himself in battle repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 萬歷七年，實授同知。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Wanli, he was formally appointed vice prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Wanli, he received formal appointment as vice prefect.

sentences.zh: 子應祖從征三鄉，親獲賊首，詔賞銀百兩。

translations.literal: His son Yingzu followed the campaign against Sanxiang, personally captured the bandit chief, and an edict rewarded him with one hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yingzu served in the campaign against Sanxiang, personally captured the rebel leader, and was rewarded by edict with one hundred taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 播州之役，征其兵三千討尋甸叛目，皆有功，賜四品服。

translations.literal: In the Bozhou campaign, three thousand of its troops were mobilized to suppress the rebellious chieftain of Xundian; all achieved merit, and they were granted fourth-rank robes.
translations.idiomatic: During the Bozhou campaign, three thousand of its troops were mobilized against the Xundian rebel chieftain. They all served with distinction and were granted fourth-rank robes.

sentences.zh: 儂氏自文舉藉四門舍目推擁之力得授職，後儂氏襲替必因之。

translations.literal: The Nong clan, from Wenju onward, obtained office through the pushing support of the four-gate shemu; afterward every Nong succession had to rely on them.
translations.idiomatic: From Wenju onward, the Nong clan owed its appointments to the backing of the four-gate shemu, and every later succession in the clan depended on them.

sentences.zh: 土官之政出於四門，租稅僅取十之一。

translations.literal: The governance of the native officials issued from the four gates; rent and tax were taken at only one in ten.
translations.idiomatic: Native officials governed through the four gates and collected only a tenth of the harvest in rent and tax.

sentences.zh: 道險多瘴，知府不至其地，印以臨安指揮一人署之。

translations.literal: The roads were perilous and malarial vapors abundant; the prefect did not go to the place, and the seal was entrusted to one commander of Lin'an to administer in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: The routes were treacherous and malarial, so the prefect never went there in person. A Lin'an commander held the seal and administered affairs in his place.

sentences.zh: 指揮出，印封一室，入取，必有瘟癘死亡。

translations.literal: When the commander went out, the seal was sealed in a room; whoever entered to take it would invariably die of pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: When the commander left, the seal was locked in a room. Whoever entered to retrieve it invariably died of plague.

sentences.zh: 萬歷末，知府廖鉉者，避瘴臨安，以印付同知儂仕英子添壽。

translations.literal: At the end of Wanli, Prefect Liao Xuan, avoiding the miasma, stayed at Lin'an and entrusted the seal to Vice Prefect Nong Shiying's son Tianshou.
translations.idiomatic: Near the end of the Wanli reign, Prefect Liao Xuan, avoiding the malarial climate, remained at Lin'an and entrusted the seal to Vice Prefect Nong Shiying's son Tianshou.

sentences.zh: 添壽死，家奴竊印並經歷司印以逃，既而歸印於其族叔儂仕祥。

translations.literal: When Tianshou died, a household slave stole the seal together with the seal of the administrative secretary's office and fled; afterward he returned the seal to his clansman-uncle Nong Shixiang.
translations.idiomatic: After Tianshou died, a household slave stole the prefectural seal and the administrative secretary's seal and fled, later returning them to his clansman Nong Shixiang.

sentences.zh: 時仕英親弟仕獬例得襲，索仕祥印，仕祥不與，遂獻地與泗城土官岑接，與連婚構兵，滅仕獬家。

translations.literal: At that time Shiying's younger brother by blood, Shixie, was by precedent entitled to succeed; he demanded Shixiang's seal, but Shixiang would not give it; he then ceded territory to the Sicheng native official Cen Jie, formed an alliance by marriage, raised troops, and destroyed Shixie's household.
translations.idiomatic: Shiying's younger brother Shixie was entitled to succeed by precedent and demanded the seal from Shixiang, who refused. Shixiang then ceded land to Sicheng native official Cen Jie, allied with him through marriage, raised troops, and destroyed Shixie's family.

sentences.zh: 及仕祥死，子琳以府印送接，而經歷司印又為琳弟瓊所有。

translations.literal: When Shixiang died, his son Lin sent the prefectural seal to Jie, while the administrative secretary's seal was again held by Lin's younger brother Qiong.
translations.idiomatic: When Shixiang died, his son Lin surrendered the prefectural seal to Jie, while the administrative secretary's seal remained with Lin's younger brother Qiong.

sentences.zh: 巡撫王懋中調兵往問，瓊懼，還印於通判周憲，接亦出府印獻於官。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Wang Maozhong mobilized troops to go and investigate; Qiong feared this, returned the seal to Assistant Prefect Zhou Xian, and Jie also produced the prefectural seal and presented it to the authorities.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Wang Maozhong mobilized troops to investigate. Qiong, alarmed, returned the seal to Assistant Prefect Zhou Xian, and Jie also surrendered the prefectural seal to the authorities.

sentences.zh: 時兵方調至境，遽遣歸。

translations.literal: At that time the troops had just been mobilized to the border when they were suddenly sent back.
translations.idiomatic: The troops had only just reached the border when they were abruptly sent home.

sentences.zh: 廷議治鉉擅離與守巡失撫之罪，瓊、接已輸服，勿問，詔可。

translations.literal: The court deliberated on punishing Xuan for unauthorized departure and the defense and patrol officials for failure to pacify; Qiong and Jie had already submitted in defeat, so they were not prosecuted; an edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The court debated punishing Xuan for abandoning his post and the local defense officials for failing to maintain order. Since Qiong and Jie had already submitted, they were not prosecuted. An edict approved the decision.

sentences.zh: 未幾，儂紹湯兄弟爭襲，各糾交阯兵象，焚掠一空。

translations.literal: Before long, the brothers Nong Shaotang contended over succession; each summoned Jiaozhi troops and elephants, and everything was burned and plundered clean.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, the Nong Shaotang brothers fought over succession, each calling in Jiaozhi troops and war elephants until the region was burned and looted bare.

sentences.zh: 廣西，隋屬牂州，後為東僰、烏蠻等部所居。

translations.literal: Guangxi was under Zang Prefecture in Sui; afterward it was inhabited by the Eastern Bo, Wuman, and other departments.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi had belonged to Zang Prefecture under the Sui, but later came to be inhabited by the Eastern Bo, Wuman, and other tribal groups.

sentences.zh: 唐隸黔州都督府。

translations.literal: In Tang it was subordinate to the Qianzhou Area Command.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it fell under the Qianzhou Area Command.

sentences.zh: 後師宗、彌勒二部浸盛，蒙、段皆莫能制。

translations.literal: Afterward the two departments of Shizong and Mile gradually grew strong; neither the Meng nor the Duan could control them.
translations.idiomatic: Later the Shizong and Mile tribes grew increasingly powerful, beyond the control of either the Meng or the Duan clans.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗時始內屬。

translations.literal: In the time of Emperor Xianzong of Yuan it first submitted internally.
translations.idiomatic: It first submitted to Yuan rule during the reign of Emperor Xianzong.

sentences.zh: 至元十二年籍二部為軍，置廣西路。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan the two departments were registered as soldiers and Guangxi Circuit was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Zhiyuan, the two tribes were registered for military service and Guangxi Circuit was established.

sentences.zh: 洪武十四年歸附，以土官普德署府事。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Hongwu it submitted; the native official Pu De was appointed to administer the prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Hongwu it submitted, and native official Pu De was appointed to administer the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十年，普德及彌勒知州赤善、師宗知州阿的各遣人貢馬，詔賜文綺鈔錠。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, Pu De and Mile Prefect Chi Shan and Shizong Prefect A Di each dispatched men to present horses as tribute; an edict bestowed patterned silks and paper money ingots.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, Pu De, Mile Prefect Chi Shan, and Shizong Prefect A Di each sent envoys with horses as tribute. The court responded with patterned silks and paper money ingots.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，布政使張紞奏：「維摩、雲龍、永寧、浪渠、越順等州縣蠻民頑惡，不遵政教，宜置兵戍守，以控制之。」

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Administrative Commissioner Zhang He memorialized: "The barbarian peoples of the prefectures and counties of Weimo, Yunlong, Yongning, Langqu, Yueshun, and others are stubborn and wicked and do not follow government instruction; troops should be stationed to garrison and control them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, Administrative Commissioner Zhang He memorialized that the tribal peoples of Weimo, Yunlong, Yongning, Langqu, Yueshun, and neighboring districts were unruly and defied government authority, and that garrisons should be established to keep them under control.

sentences.zh: 是後，朝貢賜予如制。

translations.literal: From then on, court audiences and tribute bestowals followed established regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter tribute missions and imperial gifts followed the usual regulations.

sentences.zh: 正統六年，總兵官沐昂奏師宗州及廣南府賊阿羅、阿思糾合為亂，命昂等招諭，未幾平。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhengtong, Regional Commander Mu Ang memorialized that bandits A Luo and A Si of Shizong Prefecture and Guangnan Prefecture had joined together in rebellion; Mu Ang and others were ordered to summon and persuade them; before long it was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Zhengtong, Regional Commander Mu Ang reported that the rebels A Luo and A Si of Shizong Prefecture and Guangnan Prefecture had joined forces. Mu Ang and his colleagues were ordered to summon and win them over, and the disturbance was soon put down.

sentences.zh: 成化中，土知府昂貴有罪，革其職，安置彌勒州，乃置流官，始築土城。

translations.literal: During Chenghua, the native prefect Ang Gui was guilty of crime; his office was revoked, he was resettled at Mile Prefecture, regular officials were then appointed, and an earthen city wall was first built.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chenghua reign, native prefect Ang Gui was found guilty. He was removed from office and resettled at Mile Prefecture, regular officials were installed in his place, and an earthen walled town was built for the first time.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年設雲南彌勒州十八寨守禦千戶所。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiajing the Yunnan Mile Prefecture Eighteen Stockaded Villages Defense Garrison Battalion was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiajing, the Yunnan Mile Prefecture Eighteen Stockades Defense Garrison was established.

sentences.zh: 其部眾好擄掠，無紀律，至水西、烏撒用兵，始征調之。

translations.literal: Their followers were fond of raiding and plundering and had no discipline; only when troops were deployed at Shuixi and Wusa were they first levied for service.
translations.idiomatic: Their followers were given to raiding and lacked discipline; they were not called up for service until campaigns were launched at Shuixi and Wusa.

sentences.zh: 崇禎間，巡按御史傅宗龍由滇入黔，招普兵以行。

translations.literal: During Chongzhen, Censor-in-Chief Fu Zonglong entered Guizhou from Yunnan and recruited Pu troops to accompany him.
translations.idiomatic: In the Chongzhen era, touring censor Fu Zonglong traveled from Yunnan into Guizhou and enlisted Pu troops to accompany his mission.

sentences.zh: 時滇中最稱沙普兵，亦曰昂兵。

translations.literal: At the time the Sha Pu troops were considered the finest in Yunnan; they were also called Ang troops.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Sha Pu troops were regarded as the best fighters in Yunnan and were also known as the Ang troops.

sentences.zh: 鎮沅，古濮、洛雜蠻所居，《元史》謂是和泥、昔樸二蠻也。

translations.literal: Zhenyuan was where the ancient Pu and Luo mixed barbarians lived; the History of Yuan says they were the He Ni and Xi Pu two tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenyuan was home to the ancient Pu and Luo peoples. The History of Yuan identifies them as the He Ni and Xi Pu tribes.

sentences.zh: 唐南詔蒙氏銀生府地。

translations.literal: In Tang it was the land of Yinsheng Prefecture under the Meng clan of Nanzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it had formed part of Yinsheng Prefecture in the Nanzhao realm of the Meng clan.

sentences.zh: 其後，金齒僰蠻據之。

translations.literal: Afterwards the Jinchi Bo barbarians seized it.
translations.idiomatic: Later it was taken over by the Jinchi Bo tribes.

sentences.zh: 元時為威遠蠻棚府，屬元江路總管。

translations.literal: In Yuan times it was Weiyuan Man Peng Prefecture, subordinate to the Yuanjiang Road Administrative Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was organized as Weiyuan Man Peng Prefecture, under the jurisdiction of the Yuanjiang Road commissioner.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年，總管刀平與兄那直歸附，授千夫長。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu, Administrative Commissioner Dao Ping and his elder brother Na Zhi submitted; they were appointed chiliarchs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu, Commissioner Dao Ping and his elder brother Na Zhi submitted to the Ming and were appointed chiliarchs.

sentences.zh: 建文四年置鎮沅州，以刀平為知州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jianwen Zhenyuan Prefecture was established and Dao Ping was made prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Jianwen reign, Zhenyuan Prefecture was created and Dao Ping was appointed its prefect.

sentences.zh: 永樂三年，刀平率其子來朝，貢方物，賜鈔文綺。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongle, Dao Ping led his sons to court, presented local products as tribute, and received paper money and patterned silks.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongle, Dao Ping brought his sons to court with local products as tribute and was rewarded with paper money and patterned silks.

sentences.zh: 從征八百，又從攻石崖、者達寨外部。

translations.literal: He joined the campaign against Babai, and again joined attacks on the outer sectors of Shiya and Zheda stockades.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in the campaign against Babai and later joined assaults on the outer defenses of the Shiya and Zheda stockades.

sentences.zh: 整線來降，入貢方物。

translations.literal: Zheng Xian came in submission and presented local products as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Xian submitted and sent local products as tribute.

sentences.zh: 升為府，以刀平為知府，置經歷、知事各一員。

translations.literal: It was promoted to a prefecture; Dao Ping was made prefect; one registrar and one clerk were each appointed.
translations.idiomatic: The district was raised to prefectural status, Dao Ping was appointed prefect, and one registrar and one clerk were installed.

sentences.zh: 貢賜皆如例。

translations.literal: Tribute missions and bestowals all followed precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute and imperial gifts thereafter followed the usual practice.

sentences.zh: 成化十七年，以地方未平，免鎮沅諸土官朝覲。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Chenghua, because the region was not yet pacified, the native officials of Zhenyuan were exempted from court audiences.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Chenghua, because the area remained unsettled, the native officials of Zhenyuan were excused from traveling to court.

sentences.zh: 正統元年復免。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengtong they were again exempted.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhengtong the exemption was renewed.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖中征安銓，調鎮沅兵千人，命刀寧息領之。

translations.literal: During Jiajing, when campaigning against An Quan, a thousand Zhenyuan troops were mobilized and Dao Ningxi was ordered to lead them.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jiajing reign, in the campaign against An Quan, a thousand Zhenyuan troops were mobilized under the command of Dao Ningxi.

sentences.zh: 復調其子刀仁，亦率兵千人，征那鑒，克魚復寨。

translations.literal: His son Dao Ren was again mobilized; he also led a thousand troops against Na Jian and captured Yufu Stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Dao Ningxi's son Dao Ren was called up in turn with another thousand men, fought Na Jian, and took Yufu Stockade.

sentences.zh: 初，鎮沅印為那氏所奪，至是得印以獻，命給之。

translations.literal: Initially the Zhenyuan seal had been seized by the Na clan; at this time the seal was recovered and presented; an order was issued to grant it.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhenyuan seal had earlier been seized by the Na clan; when it was recovered and presented on this occasion, the court ordered that it be returned to its rightful holder.

sentences.zh: 領長官司一，曰祿谷寨，永樂十年置。

translations.literal: It had one native official chief commission: Lugu Stockade, established in the tenth year of Yongle.
translations.idiomatic: It administered one native chief commission, Lugu Stockade, established in the tenth year of Yongle.

sentences.zh: 永寧，昔樓頭夾地，接吐蕃，又名答藍。

translations.literal: Yongning was formerly a narrow strip of land at Loutou, bordering Tibet; it was also called Dalen.
translations.idiomatic: Yongning had once been a narrow corridor at Loutou adjoining Tibetan territory and was also known as Dalen.

sentences.zh: 唐屬南詔，後為麽些蠻所據。

translations.literal: In Tang it belonged to Nanzhao; later it was seized by the Mosuo barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang it had belonged to Nanzhao, but later fell under Mosuo control.

sentences.zh: 元憲宗時內附，至元間，置答藍管民官，尋改永寧州，隸北勝府。

translations.literal: During the reign of Möngke Khan it submitted; in the Zhiyuan era the Dalen People-Managing Official was established; soon after it was changed to Yongning Prefecture, subordinate to Beisheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: It submitted during the reign of Möngke Khan. In the Zhiyuan period a Dalen native administrator was appointed; the district was soon renamed Yongning Prefecture and placed under Beisheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 洪武平雲南時，屬鶴慶府。

translations.literal: When Hongwu pacified Yunnan it belonged to Heqing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the Hongwu armies pacified Yunnan, Yongning came under Heqing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，改屬瀾滄衛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year it was transferred to Lancang Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year its jurisdiction was transferred to Lancang Guard.

sentences.zh: 十二月，土賊卜百如加劫殺軍民，前軍都督僉事何福遣指揮李榮等討之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the native bandit Bu Bairujia robbed and killed soldiers and civilians; former Assistant Regional Commander-in-Chief He Fu dispatched Commander Li Rong and others to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the native rebel Bu Bairujia raided and killed soldiers and civilians. Former Assistant Regional Commander He Fu sent Commander Li Rong and others against him.

sentences.zh: 其子阿沙遁入革失瓦都寨，官軍賫三日糧，深入追之，會天大雨，眾饑疲，引還。

translations.literal: His son A Sha fled into Geshiwadu Stockade; the government troops carried three days' rations and pursued deep in; they met with heavy rain, the men were hungry and exhausted, and they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: His son A Sha escaped into Geshiwadu Stockade. Government troops pursued with only three days' provisions, but heavy rain left the men hungry and exhausted, and they turned back.

sentences.zh: 永樂四年設四長官司，隸永寧土官，以土酋張首等為長官，各給印章，賜冠帶彩幣。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongle four native official chief commissions were established, subordinate to the Yongning native official; the tribal chiefs Zhang Shou and others were appointed chief commissioners; each was given a seal and bestowed caps, sashes, and colored silks.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Yongle four chief commissions were created under the Yongning native official. Tribal chiefs including Zhang Shou were appointed commissioners, given seals, and granted caps, sashes, and colored silks.

sentences.zh: 尋升永寧為府，隸布政司，升土知州各吉八合知府，遣之賫敕往大西番撫諭蠻眾。

translations.literal: Soon Yongning was promoted to a prefecture, subordinate to the Provincial Administration Commission; the native prefect Gejibahe was promoted to prefect and dispatched bearing an imperial edict to pacify and persuade the barbarian masses in Greater Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: Yongning was soon raised to prefectural rank under the provincial administration. Native prefect Gejibahe was promoted to prefect and sent with an imperial edict to pacify the tribal peoples of Greater Tibet.

sentences.zh: 宣德四年，永寧蠻寨矢不剌非糾四川鹽井衛土官馬剌非殺各吉八合，官軍撫定之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xuande, Yongning barbarian stockade Shibulafei incited Sichuan Yanjing Guard native official Malafei to kill Gejibahe; government troops pacified the situation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Xuande, Shibulafei of a Yongning tribal stockade persuaded Yanjing Guard native official Malafei of Sichuan to kill Gejibahe. Government troops restored order.

sentences.zh: 命卜撒襲知府，復為矢不剌非所殺。

translations.literal: Busa was ordered to inherit the prefecture; he was again killed by Shibulafei.
translations.idiomatic: Busa was appointed to succeed as prefect, but Shibulafei killed him as well.

sentences.zh: 已，命卜撒之弟南八襲，馬剌非又據永寧節卜、上、下三村，逐南八，大掠夜白、尖住、促卜瓦諸寨。

translations.literal: Then Busa's younger brother Nanba was ordered to inherit; Malafei again seized Yongning's Jiebu and Upper and Lower Three Villages, drove out Nanba, and raided the stockades of Yebai, Jianzhu, Cubuwa, and others on a large scale.
translations.idiomatic: Busa's younger brother Nanba was then appointed successor. Malafei seized Jiebu and the upper and lower villages of Yongning, expelled Nanba, and launched major raids against Yebai, Jianzhu, Cubuwa, and other stockades.

sentences.zh: 事聞，帝命都督同知沐昂勒兵諭以禍福，並移檄四川行都司下鹽井衛諭馬剌非還所據村寨。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the emperor ordered Vice Regional Commander Mu Ang to lead troops and instruct them on fortune and calamity, and also sent a dispatch to the Sichuan Regional Military Commission ordering Yanjing Guard to instruct Malafei to return the seized stockades and villages.
translations.idiomatic: When word reached the throne, the emperor ordered Vice Regional Commander Mu Ang to march with troops and warn the parties of the consequences, and also sent a dispatch through the Sichuan military command directing Yanjing Guard to order Malafei to restore the seized villages and stockades.

sentences.zh: 正統二年，馬剌非為南八所攻，拔烏節等寨，南八亦言馬剌非殺害。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengtong, Malafei was attacked by Nanba and lost Wujie and other stockades; Nanba also reported that Malafei had killed people.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhengtong, Nanba attacked Malafei and captured Wujie and other stockades. Nanba in turn accused Malafei of murder.

sentences.zh: 詔鎮巡官驗問，令各歸侵地，乃寢。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the frontier patrol officials to investigate; each was ordered to return encroached territory; then the matter was laid to rest.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed frontier officials to investigate, ordered each side to restore seized territory, and the affair was then closed.

sentences.zh: 永寧界，東至四川鹽井衛十五里，西至麗江寶山州，南至浪渠州，北至西番。

translations.literal: Yongning's borders: east to Sichuan Yanjing Guard fifteen li, west to Lijiang Baoshan Prefecture, south to Langqu Prefecture, north to the Western Barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Yongning's boundaries ran fifteen li east to Sichuan's Yanjing Guard, west to Lijiang's Baoshan Prefecture, south to Langqu Prefecture, and north to the Tibetan frontier.

sentences.zh: 領長官司四，曰剌次和，曰瓦魯之，曰革甸，曰香羅。

translations.literal: It had four native official chief commissions: Lacihe, Waluzhi, Gedian, and Xiangluo.
translations.idiomatic: It administered four chief commissions: Lacihe, Waluzhi, Gedian, and Xiangluo.

sentences.zh: 順寧府，本蒲蠻地，名慶甸。

translations.literal: Shunning Prefecture was originally Pu barbarian territory, called Qingdian.
translations.idiomatic: Shunning Prefecture had originally been Pu tribal country known as Qingdian.

sentences.zh: 宋以前不通中國，雖蒙氏、段氏不能制。

translations.literal: Before Song it had no contact with China; even the Meng and Duan clans could not control it.
translations.idiomatic: Before the Song it had no regular contact with China, and even the Meng and Duan dynasties had been unable to subdue it.

sentences.zh: 元泰定間始內附。

translations.literal: During the Taiding era of Yuan it first submitted.
translations.idiomatic: It first submitted to the Yuan during the Taiding period.

sentences.zh: 天歷初，置順寧府並慶甸縣，後省入府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianli, Shunning Prefecture and Qingdian County were established; later the county was merged into the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Tianli reign Shunning Prefecture and Qingdian County were created; the county was later abolished and absorbed into the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年，順寧歸附，以土酋阿悅貢署府事。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu, Shunning submitted; the tribal chief Ayuegong was appointed to administer the prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu Shunning submitted, and tribal chief Ayuegong was put in charge of prefectural administration.

sentences.zh: 十七年命阿日貢為順寧知府。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Ari Gong was appointed Shunning Prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year Ari Gong was appointed prefect of Shunning.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，土酋猛丘、土知府子丘等，不輸征賦，自相仇殺。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, tribal chiefs Mengqiu, native prefect Ziqiu, and others failed to pay levies and taxes and killed one another in feud.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year tribal chief Mengqiu, native prefect Ziqiu, and others refused to pay taxes and fell into mutual bloodshed.

sentences.zh: 大理衛指揮鄭祥征蒙化賊，移師至甸頭，破其寨。

translations.literal: Dali Guard Commander Zheng Xiang campaigned against Menghua bandits, moved his army to Diantou, and stormed their stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Dali Guard Commander Zheng Xiang, campaigning against bandits in Menghua, shifted his forces to Diantou and overran their stockade.

sentences.zh: 猛丘請降輸賦，乃還。

translations.literal: Mengqiu requested to surrender and pay taxes; then he returned.
translations.idiomatic: Mengqiu offered to submit and resume tax payments, and the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 猛丘死，把事阿羅等復起兵相攻擊。

translations.literal: When Mengqiu died, steward A Luo and others again raised troops and attacked one another.
translations.idiomatic: After Mengqiu's death, his steward A Luo and others again took up arms against one another.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，西平侯沐春遣鄭祥與指揮李榮等，分道進討，擒阿羅等誅之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, Western Pacification Marquis Mu Chun dispatched Zheng Xiang and Commander Li Rong and others to advance by separate routes and suppress them; A Luo and others were captured and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Western Pacification Marquis Mu Chun sent Zheng Xiang and Commander Li Rong against them by separate routes. A Luo and his followers were captured and executed.

sentences.zh: 後貢賜如制。

translations.literal: Later tribute missions and bestowals followed established regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter tribute and imperial gifts followed the usual regulations.

sentences.zh: 順寧與大侯接境。

translations.literal: Shunning bordered on Dahu.
translations.idiomatic: Shunning shared a border with Dahu.

sentences.zh: 萬歷中，大侯土舍奉赦、奉學兄弟不相能。

translations.literal: During Wanli, the Dahu native chieftains Feng She and Feng Xue, brothers, could not get along.
translations.idiomatic: During the Wanli reign, the Dahu native chieftains Feng She and Feng Xue, who were brothers, were at odds with each other.

sentences.zh: 奉學倚妻父土知府猛廷瑞，與兄赦日構兵。

translations.literal: Feng Xue relied on his wife's father, native prefect Meng Tingrui, and daily raised troops against his elder brother She.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Xue, backed by his father-in-law native prefect Meng Tingrui, kept his elder brother She under daily military pressure.

sentences.zh: 巡撫陳用賓檄參將李先著、副使邵以仁勘處。

translations.literal: Grand Coordinator Chen Yongbin dispatched orders to Regional Vice Commander Li Xianzhu and Vice Commissioner Shao Yiren to investigate and settle the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Coordinator Chen Yongbin ordered Regional Vice Commander Li Xianzhu and Vice Commissioner Shao Yiren to investigate and resolve the dispute.

sentences.zh: 以仁襲執廷瑞，因請改順寧為流官。

translations.literal: Yiren seized Tingrui in a surprise attack and then requested that Shunning be converted to regular officials.
translations.idiomatic: Shao Yiren seized Tingrui by surprise and then petitioned to replace native rule in Shunning with regular officials.

sentences.zh: 先著被檄，極言不可討，被謗語，逮下獄瘐死。

translations.literal: Xianzhu received the dispatch and strongly argued that an expedition was inadvisable; he was slandered, arrested, thrown into prison, and died there from illness.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xianzhu, receiving the order, argued forcefully against military action. He was slandered, arrested, imprisoned, and died there of illness.

sentences.zh: 然廷瑞實無反謀，以參將吳顯忠覘其富，誣以助惡，索金不應，遂讒於巡按張應揚，轉告巡撫陳用賓。

translations.literal: But Tingrui in fact had no plans for rebellion; Regional Vice Commander Wu Xianzhong, coveting his wealth, falsely accused him of abetting evil; when he demanded gold and received no response, he slandered him to Censor Zhang Yingyang, who passed the report to Grand Coordinator Chen Yongbin.
translations.idiomatic: In truth Tingrui had no rebellious intent. Regional Vice Commander Wu Xianzhong, eyeing his wealth, falsely accused him of abetting violence. When Tingrui refused his demand for gold, Wu slandered him to touring censor Zhang Yingyang, who relayed the charge to Grand Coordinator Chen Yongbin.

sentences.zh: 廷瑞大恐，不得已斬奉學以獻。

translations.literal: Tingrui was greatly frightened and, having no choice, executed Feng Xue and presented his head.
translations.idiomatic: Terrified, Tingrui had no choice but to execute Feng Xue and present his head to the authorities.

sentences.zh: 顯忠益誣其陰事，傅以反狀，撫按會奏，得旨大剿。

translations.literal: Xianzhong further fabricated secret dealings against him, attached charges of rebellion, and the grand coordinator and censor jointly memorialized; they received imperial approval for a major punitive campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Xianzhong added further false charges of secret treachery, framed him for rebellion, and the provincial officials jointly memorialized the throne. Imperial approval was granted for a major punitive expedition.

sentences.zh: 廷瑞出，獻印獻子以候命，不從。

translations.literal: Tingrui came out, presented his seal and his son and awaited orders; the court did not accept.
translations.idiomatic: Tingrui came forward, surrendered his seal and his son, and awaited judgment, but the court would not listen.

sentences.zh: 顯忠帥兵入其寨，盡取猛氏十八代蓄貲數百萬，誘廷瑞至會城執之，獻捷於朝。

translations.literal: Xianzhong led troops into his stockade, seized the Meng clan's accumulated wealth of eighteen generations totaling millions, lured Tingrui to Huicheng and seized him, and presented a victory report to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Xianzhong marched into Tingrui's stockade, plundered the Meng family's accumulated wealth of eighteen generations—worth millions—and lured Tingrui to the prefectural seat, where he was seized. Wu then reported a victory to the court.

sentences.zh: 於是所部十三寨盡憤，始聚兵反，官兵悉剿除之，並殺其子。

translations.literal: Thereupon all thirteen stockades under his command were enraged and first gathered troops in rebellion; government troops completely exterminated them and killed his son as well.
translations.idiomatic: All thirteen stockades under his command rose in outrage and took up arms. Government troops wiped them out entirely and killed his son as well.

sentences.zh: 以仁超擢右都御史，蔭子。

translations.literal: Yiren was rapidly promoted to Right Censor-in-Chief and his son received hereditary privilege.
translations.idiomatic: Shao Yiren was swiftly promoted to Right Censor-in-Chief, and his son received an official privilege by inheritance.

sentences.zh: 未幾坐大辟，系獄，應揚亦病卒。

translations.literal: Before long he was charged with a capital offense and imprisoned; Yingyang also died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Shao Yiren was convicted of a capital crime and imprisoned. Zhang Yingyang also died of illness.

sentences.zh: 人以為天道雲。

translations.literal: People regarded it as the way of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: People took it as Heaven's retribution.

sentences.zh: 順寧附境有猛猛、猛撒、猛緬，所謂三猛也。

translations.literal: On Shunning's borders were Mengmeng, Mengsa, and Mengmian—the so-called Three Mengs.
translations.idiomatic: Along Shunning's frontier lay Mengmeng, Mengsa, and Mengmian, known collectively as the Three Mengs.

sentences.zh: 猛猛最強，部落萬人，時與二猛為難。

translations.literal: Mengmeng was strongest, with a tribe of ten thousand; it often had trouble with the other two Mengs.
translations.idiomatic: Mengmeng was the strongest, with a tribe of ten thousand, and frequently clashed with the other two Mengs.

sentences.zh: 其地田少箐多，射獵為業。

translations.literal: Their land had little farmland and many ravines; hunting with bow was their livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: Their country had little arable land and many ravines, and they lived mainly by hunting.

sentences.zh: 猛緬地雖廣，而人柔弱。

translations.literal: Mengmian's territory was broad but its people weak and soft.
translations.idiomatic: Mengmian's territory was extensive, but its people were mild and unwarlike.

sentences.zh: 部長賜冠帶，最忠順。

translations.literal: Its tribal chief was granted cap and sash; he was most loyal and compliant.
translations.idiomatic: Its chief had been granted cap and sash and was the most loyal and obedient of the three.

sentences.zh: 猛撒微弱，後折入於耿馬雲。

translations.literal: Mengsa was weak; later it was absorbed into Gengma.
translations.idiomatic: Mengsa was weak and was later absorbed into Gengma.

sentences.zh: 蒙化，唐屬姚州都督府。

translations.literal: Menghua in Tang belonged to Yaozhou Area Command.
translations.idiomatic: Menghua had belonged under the Tang to the Yaozhou Area Command.

sentences.zh: 蒙氏時，細奴邏築城居之，號蒙舍詔。

translations.literal: During the Meng clan's rule, Xinuluo built a city and dwelt there; it was called Mengshe Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Meng clan, Xinuluo built a walled settlement there and named it Mengshe Zhao.

sentences.zh: 段氏改開南縣。

translations.literal: The Duan clan changed it to Kainan County.
translations.idiomatic: The Duan clan reorganized it as Kainan County.

sentences.zh: 元為州，屬大理。

translations.literal: In Yuan it was a prefecture, subordinate to Dali.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was made a prefecture under Dali.

sentences.zh: 洪武十七年以土酋左禾為蒙化州判官、施生為正千夫長。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Hongwu the tribal chief Zuo He was appointed Menghua Prefecture Assistant Prefect and Shi Sheng was made Senior Chiliarch.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Hongwu tribal chief Zuo He was appointed assistant prefect of Menghua and Shi Sheng was made senior chiliarch.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，西平侯沐英以蒙化所屬蠻火頭字青等梗化不服，請置衛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Western Pacification Marquis Mu Ying reported that the barbarian fire-heads Ziqing and others under Menghua obstructed transformation and would not submit; he requested establishing a guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Western Pacification Marquis Mu Ying reported that tribal headmen such as Ziqing under Menghua resisted assimilation and refused to submit, and requested that a guard be established.

sentences.zh: 命指揮僉事李聚守蒙化。

translations.literal: Commander Li Ju was ordered to garrison Menghua.
translations.idiomatic: Commander Li Ju was ordered to take charge of the Menghua garrison.

sentences.zh: 賊高天惠作亂，大理衛指揮使鄭祥捕斬之，傳首雲南。

translations.literal: The bandit Gao Tianhui raised rebellion; Dali Guard Commander Zheng Xiang captured and executed him and sent his head to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebel Gao Tianhui rose in revolt, Dali Guard Commander Zheng Xiang captured and executed him and sent his head to the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 永樂九年，土知州左禾、正千夫長阿束來朝，貢馬，賜予如例。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Yongle, native prefect Zuo He and Senior Chiliarch A Shu came to court, presented horses, and received bestowals according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Yongle native prefect Zuo He and senior chiliarch A Shu came to court with horses as tribute and received gifts according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 既，左伽從征麓川，戰於大侯，功第一，進秩臨安知府，掌州事。

translations.literal: Afterwards Zuo Jia joined the campaign against Luchuan; fighting at Dahu he ranked first in merit; he was promoted to Lin'an Prefect and managed prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zuo Jia joined the Luchuan campaign and, fighting at Dahu, won first merit. He was promoted to Lin'an Prefect while continuing to administer Menghua.

sentences.zh: 正統中，升州為府，以左伽為知府，世襲。

translations.literal: During Zhengtong the prefecture was promoted to a fu; Zuo Jia was made prefect, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhengtong reign the district was raised from prefecture to fu, and Zuo Jia was appointed hereditary prefect.

sentences.zh: 所部江內諸蠻，性柔，頗馴擾，江外數枝，以勇悍稱。

translations.literal: The barbarians within the river in his jurisdiction were mild in nature and fairly tractable though sometimes troublesome; several branches beyond the river were famed for fierce bravery.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes on the inner side of the river were mild by nature and fairly tractable though occasionally unruly; several branches beyond the river were renowned for fierce fighting.

sentences.zh: 每應征調，多野戰，無行伍。

translations.literal: Whenever levied for service, they mostly fought in the field without formation.
translations.idiomatic: When called up for service they usually fought in open country without formal battle order.

sentences.zh: 成化十七年，巡撫奏地方未寧，免蒙化土官明年朝貢。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Chenghua the grand coordinator memorialized that the region was unsettled and exempted Menghua native officials from next year's court tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Chenghua the grand coordinator reported that the region was still unsettled and secured exemption for Menghua native officials from the following year's tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 正統元年詔復免。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhengtong an edict again granted exemption.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhengtong an edict renewed the exemption.

sentences.zh: 萬歷四十八年，雲龍土知州段龍死，子嘉龍立，養子進忠殺嘉龍爭襲，流劫殺掠。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year of Wanli, Yunlong native prefect Duan Long died; his son Jialong succeeded; the adopted son Jinzhong killed Jialong to fight for succession and went about plundering and killing.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year of Wanli Yunlong native prefect Duan Long died and his son Jialong succeeded. The adopted son Jinzhong murdered Jialong to seize the post and then went on a rampage of plunder and killing.

sentences.zh: 官軍進討，進忠從間道欲趨大理，官軍擒誅之，改設流官，授段氏世吏目一人。

translations.literal: Government troops advanced to suppress them; Jinzhong took a bypath intending to rush to Dali; government troops captured and executed him; regular officials were established in place of native rule; one hereditary clerk from the Duan clan was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops marched against him. Jinzhong tried to reach Dali by a side route but was captured and executed. Regular officials were installed in Yunlong, and one hereditary clerk from the Duan clan was retained.

sentences.zh: 孟艮，蠻名孟掯，自古不通中國。

translations.literal: Menggen—barbarian name Menggen—had never had contact with China since antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Menggen, known in the local tongue as Menggen, had had no contact with China since ancient times.

sentences.zh: 永樂三年來歸，設孟艮府，隸雲南都司，以土酋刀哀為知府，給印誥冠帶。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongle it submitted; Menggen Prefecture was established, subordinate to the Yunnan Regional Military Commission; the tribal chief Dao Ai was made prefect and given seal, patent of appointment, cap, and sash.
translations.idiomatic: It submitted in the third year of Yongle. Menggen Prefecture was established under the Yunnan Regional Military Commission, tribal chief Dao Ai was appointed prefect, and he was granted a seal, patent of appointment, cap, and sash.

sentences.zh: 時刀哀遣人來朝，請設治所，歲辦差髮黃金六十兩。

translations.literal: At that time Dao Ai dispatched men to court, requesting establishment of an administrative seat and yearly provision of sixty taels of gold for corvée tax.
translations.idiomatic: Dao Ai then sent envoys to court requesting an administrative seat and undertaking to supply sixty taels of gold annually as corvée payment.

sentences.zh: 六年，土知府刀交遣弟刀哈哄貢象及金銀器。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, native prefect Dao Jiao sent his younger brother Dao Hahong to present elephants and gold and silver vessels as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year native prefect Dao Jiao sent his younger brother Dao Hahong with elephants and gold and silver vessels as tribute.

sentences.zh: 禮部言：「刀交嘗構兵攻劫鄰境，詐譎不誠，宜卻其貢。」

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites said: "Dao Jiao has formerly raised troops to attack and raid neighboring territories; he is deceitful and insincere; his tribute should be refused.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites argued that Dao Jiao had previously raised troops to raid neighboring territories, was deceitful and untrustworthy, and that his tribute ought to be refused.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「蠻夷能悔過來朝，往事不足責。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "The barbarians are able to repent and come to court; past affairs are not worth reproaching."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied that since the tribesmen had repented and come to court, their past offenses need not be held against them.

sentences.zh: 命賜鈔及絨錦綺帛。

translations.literal: An order was issued to bestow paper money, velvet, brocade, and patterned silks.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered that paper money, velvet, brocade, and patterned silks be granted instead.

sentences.zh: 是後，貢賜皆如例。

translations.literal: After that, tribute missions and bestowals all followed precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter tribute and imperial gifts followed the usual practice.

sentences.zh: 宣德六年，命內官楊琳賫彩幣往賜孟艮知府刀光。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Xuande, eunuch Yang Lin was ordered to bear colored silks and go to bestow them on Menggen Prefect Dao Guang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Xuande the eunuch Yang Lin was dispatched with colored silks as gifts for Menggen Prefect Dao Guang.

sentences.zh: 正統間，孟艮地多為木邦所並。

translations.literal: During the Zhengtong era, much of Menggen territory was annexed by Mubang.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhengtong reign, large portions of Menggen's lands were absorbed by Mubang.

sentences.zh: 景泰中，入貢知府名慶馬辣，不知於刀氏何屬也。

translations.literal: During the Jingtai era, the prefect who came to pay tribute was named Qing Mala; it is unknown what relation he bore to the Dao clan.
translations.idiomatic: Under Jingtai, the prefect who presented tribute was called Qing Mala, though his connection to the Dao family remains unclear.

sentences.zh: 孟艮在姚關東南二千里外，沃野千里，最殷富。

translations.literal: Menggen lay two thousand li southeast of Yao Pass, with a thousand li of fertile fields — the most prosperous of all.
translations.idiomatic: Menggen stood two thousand li southeast of Yao Pass, its thousand li of rich farmland making it the wealthiest region in the area.

sentences.zh: 地多虎，農者於樹杪結草樓以護稼。

translations.literal: Tigers were numerous in the land; farmers built grass huts in the treetops to protect their crops.
translations.idiomatic: Tigers roamed the countryside in such numbers that farmers erected grass shelters in the canopy to guard their harvest.

sentences.zh: 雲南知府趙混一嘗入其境，待之禮慢，後無復至者。

translations.literal: Zhao Hunyi, prefect of Yunnan, once entered their territory and was received with scant courtesy; afterward no one went again.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhao Hunyi, the Yunnan prefect, once crossed into their lands, he was treated with deliberate disrespect, and no official ever ventured there again.

sentences.zh: 孟定

translations.literal: Mengding.
translations.idiomatic: Mengding

sentences.zh: 〈（耿馬安撫司附）〉

translations.literal: (Gengma Pacification Commission appended) 〉
translations.idiomatic: (The Gengma Pacification Commission is appended here.)]〉

sentences.zh: 孟定，蠻名景麻。

translations.literal: Mengding — the barbarian name is Jingma.
translations.idiomatic: Mengding was known among the tribes as Jingma.

sentences.zh: 至元中，立孟定路軍民總管府，領二甸，隸大理、金齒等處宣慰司。

translations.literal: In the Zhongyuan era, the Mengding Route Military-Civilian General Pacification Office was established, governing two sub-districts, subordinate to the Dali and Jinchi Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan, the court set up the Mengding Route Military-Civilian General Pacification Office over two sub-districts, placing it under the Dali and Jinchi Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 洪武十五年，土酋刀名扛來朝，貢方物，賜綺帛鈔幣，設孟定府，以刀渾立為知府。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Hongwu, tribal chieftain Dao Mingkang came to court, presenting local products; brocade silks and paper money were bestowed; Mengding Prefecture was established, and Dao Hun was installed as prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 15 the chieftain Dao Mingkang arrived at court with tribute goods. The emperor granted brocades and paper currency, created Mengding Prefecture, and appointed Dao Hun as its native prefect.

sentences.zh: 永樂二年，孟定土官刀景發遣人貢馬，賜鈔羅綺。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongle, Mengding native official Dao Jingfa sent men to present horses; paper money, gauze, and brocade were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 2 the Mengding native official Dao Jingfa dispatched envoys with horses as tribute, and the court responded with paper money, gauze, and brocade.

sentences.zh: 遣使往賜印誥、冠帶、襲衣，復頒信符、金字紅牌。

translations.literal: An envoy was sent to bestow the seal patent, hat and belt, and ceremonial robe; the credential tally and gold-lettered red plaque were again issued.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent an envoy bearing a seal patent, hat and belt, and investiture robes, and reissued the credential tally and gold-lettered red plaque.

sentences.zh: 四年，帝以孟定道里險遠，每歲朝貢不便，令自今三年一貢，如慶賀謝恩不拘例。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the emperor, because the route to Mengding was perilous and distant and annual court tribute was inconvenient, ordered that henceforth tribute be sent once every three years, while congratulatory and gratitude missions would not be bound by this rule.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the emperor ruled that, given Mengding's remote and treacherous route, annual tribute was impractical; henceforth missions would come every three years, though congratulatory and thank-offering visits remained exempt.

sentences.zh: 初，孟璉與孟定皆麓川地，其土目皆故等夷，惡相屬；

translations.literal: Initially, both Menglian and Mengding were Luxuan territory; their native headmen were all formerly of the Deng tribes, evilly connected to one another;
translations.idiomatic: At first Menglian and Mengding had both belonged to Luxuan, and their native headmen, all formerly of the Deng tribes, were bound together in mutual hostility;

sentences.zh: 後改孟璉隸雲南，多以互侵土地仇殺。

translations.literal: Later, when Menglian was reassigned to Yunnan, they often raided each other's lands in cycles of vengeance killing.
translations.idiomatic: After Menglian was placed under Yunnan, the two sides repeatedly encroached on each other's territory and settled scores in blood.

sentences.zh: 宣德六年，土知府罕顏法以為言，敕黔國公沐晟遣官撫諭，俾各歸侵掠。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Xuande, native prefect Han Yanfa spoke of this; an edict ordered Duke of Qian Mu Sheng to dispatch officials to pacify and instruct them, causing each to return what had been seized.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 6 native prefect Han Yanfa raised the matter, and the throne commanded Duke Mu Sheng of Qian to send officials to mediate, ordering both sides to restore what they had taken.

sentences.zh: 正統中，麓川叛，孟定知府刀祿孟遁走。

translations.literal: During the Zhengtong era, Luxuan rebelled, and Mengding Prefect Dao Lumeng fled.
translations.idiomatic: When Luxuan rose in rebellion during Zhengtong, Mengding Prefect Dao Lumeng abandoned his post and fled.

sentences.zh: 木邦土官罕葛從征有功，總督王驥奏令食孟定之土。

translations.literal: Mubang native official Han Ge followed the campaign with merit; Governor Wang Ji memorialized that he be granted Mengding's land to hold.
translations.idiomatic: Han Ge, the Mubang native official, distinguished himself on campaign, and Governor Wang Ji recommended that he be granted Mengding's territory as a fief.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖間，木邦罕烈據地奪印，令土舍罕慶守之，名為耿馬；

translations.literal: During the Jiajing era, Mubang's Han Lie seized territory and took the seal, placing native retainer Han Qing to guard it, naming it Gengma;
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiajing period Han Lie of Mubang seized the land and seized the seal, installing his native retainer Han Qing to hold the place under the name Gengma;

sentences.zh: 地之所入，悉歸木邦。

translations.literal: All revenues from the land went entirely to Mubang.
translations.idiomatic: Every penny of income from the territory flowed to Mubang.

sentences.zh: 萬歷十二年，官兵取隴川，平孟定故地，以罕葛之後為知府。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Wanli, government troops took Longchuan and pacified the former Mengding lands; Han Ge's descendant was made prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 12 imperial forces captured Longchuan and restored the old Mengding domain, installing a descendant of Han Ge as prefect.

sentences.zh: 十五年頒孟定府印。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the Mengding Prefecture seal was issued.
translations.idiomatic: The Mengding Prefecture seal was formally issued in the fifteenth year.

sentences.zh: 崇禎末，孟定叛，降於緬甸。

translations.literal: At the end of the Chongzhen reign, Mengding rebelled and submitted to Burma.
translations.idiomatic: In the final years of Chongzhen, Mengding broke away and surrendered to Burma.

sentences.zh: 其地，自姚關南八日程，西接隴川，東連孟璉，南木邦，北鎮康。

translations.literal: Its territory lay eight days' journey south of Yao Pass, bordering Longchuan on the west, connected to Menglian on the east, Mubang on the south, and Zhenkang on the north.
translations.idiomatic: The region stood eight days south of Yao Pass, with Longchuan to the west, Menglian to the east, Mubang to the south, and Zhenkang to the north.

sentences.zh: 土瘠人稀，有馬援城在焉。

translations.literal: The soil was poor and the population sparse; there was a Ma Yuan fort there.
translations.idiomatic: The land was thin and sparsely settled, though a fort attributed to Ma Yuan still stood there.

sentences.zh: 領安撫司一，曰耿馬。

translations.literal: It governed one Pacification Commission, namely Gengma.
translations.idiomatic: It administered a single pacification commission: Gengma.

sentences.zh: 萬歷十二年置，以們罕為安撫使。

translations.literal: Established in the twelfth year of Wanli, with Men Han as pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Created in Wanli 12, it was placed under Men Han as pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 與孟定隔喳哩江。

translations.literal: It was separated from Mengding by the Zhali River.
translations.idiomatic: Gengma and Mengding were divided by the Zhali River.

sentences.zh: 孟定居南，耿馬居北。

translations.literal: Mengding lay to the south; Gengma lay to the north.
translations.idiomatic: Mengding stood on the south bank, Gengma on the north.

sentences.zh: 罕死，弟們罕金護印，屢奉朝貢。

translations.literal: When Han died, his younger brother Men Hanjin guarded the seal and repeatedly paid court tribute.
translations.idiomatic: After Han's death his younger brother Men Hanjin kept the seal and sent tribute missions to court on several occasions.

sentences.zh: 時木邦思禮作亂，侵灣甸、鎮康，倚罕金為聲援。

translations.literal: At the time Siliao of Mubang rebelled, invading Wandian and Zhenkang, relying on Hanjin as backing.
translations.idiomatic: When Siliao of Mubang rose in revolt and raided Wandian and Zhenkang, he counted on Hanjin for support.

sentences.zh: 天啟二年，緬人攻猛乃、孟艮，罕金欲救之。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tianqi, Burmese attacked Mengnai and Menggen; Hanjin wished to rescue them.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianqi 2 the Burmese assaulted Mengnai and Menggen, and Hanjin prepared to come to their aid.

sentences.zh: 緬移兵攻金，金厚賂之，乃解。

translations.literal: Burma shifted troops to attack Jin; Jin bribed them heavily, and they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Burma then turned its forces on Hanjin, who bought them off with lavish bribes, and the siege was lifted.

sentences.zh: 後與木邦罕正構難不絕雲。

translations.literal: Afterward conflict with Mubang's Han Zheng continued without end.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter he and Han Zheng of Mubang were locked in unending feud.

sentences.zh: 曲靖，隋恭、協二州地。

translations.literal: Qujing was the territory of the Sui prefectures of Gong and Xie.
translations.idiomatic: Qujing occupied the lands of the Sui-era Gong and Xie prefectures.

sentences.zh: 唐置南寧州，改恭州為曲州，分協州置靖州，至元初，置磨彌部萬戶，後改為曲靖路宣慰司。

translations.literal: The Tang established Nanning Prefecture, changed Gong Prefecture to Qu Prefecture, split off Xie Prefecture to establish Jing Prefecture; in the early Yuan, the Mimi Department Ten-Thousand Households was established, later changed to the Qujing Route Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang the court set up Nanning Prefecture, renamed Gong to Qu Prefecture, and carved Jing Prefecture out of Xie. In early Yuan times it became the Mimi Department Ten-Thousand Households, and later the Qujing Route Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 洪武十四年，征南將軍下雲南，元曲靖宣慰司征行元帥張麟、行省平章劉輝等來降。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Hongwu, the southern expedition general descended on Yunnan; Zhang Lin, campaign marshal of the Yuan Qujing Pacification Commission, and Liu Hui, provincial vice grand councillor, and others came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 14 the southern expedition reached Yunnan, and Zhang Lin, the Yuan campaign marshal of Qujing, together with provincial vice councillor Liu Hui and others, submitted.

sentences.zh: 十五年改曲靖千戶所為曲靖軍民指揮使司，置曲靖軍民府。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the Qujing Thousand-Household Office was changed to the Qujing Military-Civilian Command, and Qujing Military-Civilian Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the Qujing Thousand-Household Office became the Qujing Military-Civilian Command, and a military-civilian prefecture was established there.

sentences.zh: 十六年，沾益州土官安索叔、安磁等貢馬及羅羅刀甲、氈衫、虎皮。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, native officials An Suoshu and An Ci of Zhanyi Prefecture presented horses, Lolo swords and armor, felt garments, and tiger skins.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 16 the Zhanyi native officials An Suoshu and An Ci sent horses plus Lolo blades and armor, felt coats, and tiger pelts as tribute.

sentences.zh: 詔賜磁、冠帶、綺羅衣各一襲並文綺、鈔錠。

translations.literal: An edict bestowed on Ci a hat and belt, one set of brocade and gauze robes each, together with patterned brocade and ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: The throne granted An Ci a hat and belt, a full set of brocade and gauze robes, patterned silks, and paper-money ingots.

sentences.zh: 羅雄州土酋納居來朝，賜鈔幣。

translations.literal: Tribal chieftain Na Ju of Luoxiong Prefecture came to court; paper money was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Na Ju, chieftain of Luoxiong Prefecture, arrived at court and received a grant of paper currency.

sentences.zh: 十七年，亦佐縣土酋安伯作亂，西平侯沐英發兵討降之。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, tribal chieftain An Bo of Yizuo County rebelled; Marquis of Xiping Mu Ying dispatched troops to attack and subdue him.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 17 the Yizuo chieftain An Bo rose in revolt, and Marquis Mu Ying of Xiping sent an expedition that brought him to heel.

sentences.zh: 二十年，越州土酋阿資與羅雄州營長發束等叛。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, tribal chieftain Azi of Yue Prefecture rebelled together with camp chief Fa Shu of Luoxiong Prefecture and others.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 20 the Yue Prefecture chieftain Azi joined Luoxiong camp chief Fa Shu and others in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 阿資者，土官龍海子也。

translations.literal: Azi was the son of native official Long Hai.
translations.idiomatic: Azi was the son of the native official Long Hai.

sentences.zh: 越州，蠻呼為苦麻部。

translations.literal: Yue Prefecture — the barbarians call it the Kuma tribe.
translations.idiomatic: The tribes called Yue Prefecture by the name Kuma.

sentences.zh: 元末，龍海居之，所屬俱羅羅斯種。

translations.literal: At the end of the Yuan, Long Hai dwelt there; those under him were all of the Lolo race.
translations.idiomatic: In the late Yuan Long Hai held the territory, and his people were all of Lolo stock.

sentences.zh: 王師征南時，英駐兵其地之湯池山。

translations.literal: When the imperial army campaigned south, Ying stationed troops at Tangchi Mountain in that territory.
translations.idiomatic: During the southern campaign Mu Ying encamped his forces at Tangchi Mountain in the region.

sentences.zh: 龍海降，遂遣子入朝，詔以龍海為知州。

translations.literal: Long Hai surrendered, then sent his son to court; an edict appointed Long Hai as prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Long Hai submitted and sent his son to court, and the throne appointed him prefect of Yue.

sentences.zh: 尋為亂，英擒之，徙遼東，至蓋州病死。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he rebelled; Ying captured him and exiled him to Liaodong; he died of illness at Gaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He soon rebelled again. Ying seized him and banished him to Liaodong, where he died of illness at Gaizhou.

sentences.zh: 阿資繼其職，益桀驁，至是叛。

translations.literal: Azi succeeded to his office, growing ever more arrogant and defiant; at this time he rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Azi inherited the post and grew increasingly unruly until he finally took up arms.

sentences.zh: 帝命英會征南將軍傅友德進討。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Ying to join the southern expedition general Fu Youde in advancing to attack.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commanded Ying to join the southern expedition commander Fu Youde in a punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 道過平夷，以其山險惡，宜駐兵屯守，遂遷其山民往居卑午村，留神策衛千戶劉成等將千人置堡其地，後以為平夷千戶所。

translations.literal: Passing through Pingyi, because its mountains were perilous and harsh, it was deemed fit to station troops for garrison duty; the mountain people were relocated to dwell at Beiwu Village; Liu Cheng and others, thousand-household commanders of the Shensce Guard, were left with a thousand men to establish a fort there; later it became the Pingyi Thousand-Household Office.
translations.idiomatic: Marching through Pingyi, the generals judged its rugged peaks too dangerous to leave unguarded. They resettled the mountain dwellers at Beiwu Village and left Liu Cheng of the Shensce Guard with a thousand men to build a fort that later became the Pingyi Thousand-Household Office.

sentences.zh: 阿資等率眾寇普安，燒府治，大肆剽掠。

translations.literal: Azi and others led their forces to raid Pu'an, burned the prefectural seat, and plundered on a great scale.
translations.idiomatic: Azi led his followers against Pu'an, torched the prefectural yamen, and looted the countryside.

sentences.zh: 友德率兵擊之，斬其營長。

translations.literal: Youde led troops to strike them and beheaded their camp chief.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Youde counterattacked and killed one of their camp chiefs.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，友德等進攻，土官普旦來降。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, Youde and others pressed the attack; native official Puddan came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 22, as Fu Youde pressed the offensive, the native official Puddan submitted.

sentences.zh: 阿資退屯普安，倚崖壁為寨。

translations.literal: Azi withdrew and encamped at Pu'an, relying on cliff walls to make a stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Azi fell back to Pu'an and fortified himself against the cliff face.

sentences.zh: 友德以精兵蹙之，蠻眾皆緣壁攀崖，墜死者不可勝數，生擒一千三百余人，獲馬畜甚眾。

translations.literal: Youde pressed them with elite troops; the barbarian masses all climbed the walls and scaled the cliffs; those who fell to their deaths were beyond counting; more than thirteen hundred were captured alive; horses and livestock taken were very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Youde drove his crack troops against them. The tribesmen scrambled up the cliffs in flight, and countless plummeted to their deaths. More than thirteen hundred were taken alive, along with a great herd of horses and livestock.

sentences.zh: 阿資遁還越州，復追擊敗之，斬其黨五十余人。

translations.literal: Azi fled back to Yue Prefecture; pursuing again, they defeated him and beheaded more than fifty of his followers.
translations.idiomatic: Azi escaped to Yue Prefecture, but pursuers caught and routed him again, killing more than fifty of his men.

sentences.zh: 阿資窮蹙請降。

translations.literal: Azi, driven to extremity, requested surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Cornered and desperate, Azi sued for peace.

sentences.zh: 初，阿資之遁也，揚言曰：「國家有萬軍之勇，我地有萬山之險，豈能盡滅我輩。」

translations.literal: Initially, when Azi fled, he proclaimed aloud: "The state has the valor of ten thousand armies, but our land has the peril of ten thousand mountains — how can you utterly destroy us all?
translations.idiomatic: When Azi first fled he had boasted: "The empire may field ten thousand brave soldiers, but our country holds ten thousand perilous peaks — you can never wipe us out entirely.

sentences.zh: 英乃請置越州、馬龍二衛，扼其險要，復分兵追捕，至是遂降。

translations.literal: Ying then requested the establishment of the two guards of Yue Prefecture and Malong to choke their strategic passes, and again divided troops to pursue and capture; at this point he finally surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Ying therefore proposed garrisoning the strategic Yue and Malong guards to block the mountain passes, then sent detachments in pursuit — and at last Azi yielded.

sentences.zh: 英等以陸涼西南要地，請設衛屯守。

translations.literal: Ying and others, because Luliang was a strategic point in the southwest, requested the establishment of a guard for garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: Ying argued that Luliang was a vital southwestern crossroads and asked that a guard be established to hold it.

sentences.zh: 命洱海衛指揮僉事滕聚於古魯昌築城，置陸涼衛指揮使司。

translations.literal: Vice commander Teng Ju of the Erhai Guard was ordered to build a city at Gulu Chang and establish the Luliang Guard Command.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Teng Ju, vice commander of the Erhai Guard, to build a walled post at Gulu Chang and establish the Luliang Guard Command.

sentences.zh: 英又言：「曲靖指揮千戶哈剌不花，乃故元守禦陸涼千戶。

translations.literal: Ying further said: "Harabuhua, thousand-household commander of Qujing, was formerly the Yuan garrison commander of the Luliang Thousand-Household Office.
translations.idiomatic: Ying added: "Harabuhua, the Qujing thousand-household commander, had served the Yuan as garrison commander at Luliang.
