sentences.zh: 今陸涼置衛，宜調於本衛鎮守，庶絕後患。」

translations.literal: Now that Luliang has a guard established, he should be transferred to garrison this guard, so that later troubles may be cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Now that a guard has been set up at Luliang, he should be reassigned to garrison it there, lest trouble arise later.

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The throne approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 帝以平夷尤當要沖，四面皆諸蠻部落，乃遣開國公常升往辰陽集民間丁壯五千人，統以右軍都督僉事王成，即平夷千戶所改置衛。

translations.literal: The emperor, because Pingyi was especially at a strategic choke point with barbarian tribes on all four sides, dispatched Duke of State-Founding Chang Sheng to Chenyang to gather five thousand able-bodied men from among the populace, placing them under Vice Commissioner of the Right Army Wang Cheng; the Pingyi Thousand-Household Office was immediately changed to establish a guard.
translations.idiomatic: Judging Pingyi the most critical pass — surrounded on every side by tribal settlements — the emperor sent Duke Chang Sheng to Chenyang to levy five thousand local men under Vice Commissioner Wang Cheng of the Right Army, converting the Pingyi Thousand-Household Office into a full guard.

sentences.zh: 二十三年置越州衛。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the Yue Prefecture Guard was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Yue Prefecture Guard was created in Hongwu 23.

sentences.zh: 二十四年徙越州衛於陸涼州；

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the Yue Prefecture Guard was moved to Luliang Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 24 the Yue Prefecture Guard was relocated to Luliang;

sentences.zh: 以英言雲南諸蠻皆降，惟阿資恃險屢叛，宜徙衛軍守禦。

translations.literal: because Ying said that all the barbarians of Yunnan had submitted except Azi, who relied on perilous terrain and repeatedly rebelled — the guard troops should be moved to garrison and defend.
translations.idiomatic: Ying had argued that while every other tribe in Yunnan had submitted, Azi alone exploited the mountains to rebel again and again, and that guard troops should be stationed to keep watch over him.

sentences.zh: 已，阿資復叛。

translations.literal: Before long, Azi rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Azi rose once more.

sentences.zh: 命都督僉事何福為平羌將軍，率師進討，屢敗賊眾。

translations.literal: Vice commissioner He Fu was appointed General Who Pacifies the Qiang and ordered to lead troops forward in attack; he repeatedly defeated the rebel forces.
translations.idiomatic: The court named Vice Commissioner He Fu General Who Pacifies the Qiang and sent him to campaign against Azi, winning several victories over the rebels.

sentences.zh: 會連月淫雨水溢，阿資援絕，與其眾降。

translations.literal: It happened that for consecutive months heavy rains caused floods; Azi's supplies were cut off, and he surrendered with his followers.
translations.idiomatic: Months of torrential rain flooded the land, cutting off Azi's supplies until he and his band capitulated.

sentences.zh: 福擇曠地列柵，以置其眾。

translations.literal: Fu chose open ground and set up palisades to settle his followers.
translations.idiomatic: He Fu selected open ground, ringed it with palisades, and resettled the surrendered tribesmen there.

sentences.zh: 西南有木蓉菁，賊常出沒處，復調普安衛官軍置寧越堡鎮之，然阿資終不悛。

translations.literal: To the southwest was Murongjing, a place where bandits often appeared and vanished; government troops of the Pu'an Guard were again transferred to establish Ningyue Fort to garrison it — yet Azi ultimately did not repent.
translations.idiomatic: Southwest lay Murongjing, a haunt of raiders; troops from the Pu'an Guard were posted at the new Ningyue Fort to hold the ground — but Azi never truly reformed.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，阿資復反。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, Azi rebelled again.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 27 Azi rebelled yet again.

sentences.zh: 西平侯沐春及福率兵營於越州城北，遣壯士伏於岐路，而以兵挑戰。

translations.literal: Marquis of Xiping Mu Chun and Fu led troops to encamp north of Yue Prefecture city, dispatching stalwart men to lie in ambush at a fork in the road while using troops to provoke battle.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis Mu Chun of Xiping and He Fu encamped north of Yue city, hid picked warriors along a fork in the road, and sent a small force forward to draw the enemy out.

sentences.zh: 蠻兵悉眾出，伏起，大敗之，阿資脫身遁。

translations.literal: The barbarian troops came out with their full force; the ambush rose and routed them utterly; Azi escaped alone and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The tribesmen marched out in full strength; the ambush sprang up and shattered them, though Azi himself slipped away.

sentences.zh: 初，曲靖土軍千戶阿保、張琳所守地，與越州接壤，部眾多相與貿易。

translations.literal: Initially, the territory guarded by native-army thousand-household commanders Abao and Zhang Lin of Qujing bordered Yue Prefecture; their followers often traded with one another.
translations.idiomatic: The lands held by the Qujing native-army commanders Abao and Zhang Lin adjoined Yue Prefecture, and their people frequently traded across the border.

sentences.zh: 春使人結阿保等，覘阿資所在及其經行地，星列守堡，絕其糧道，賊益困。

translations.literal: Chun sent men to win over Abao and others, to scout where Azi was and the routes he traveled; guard forts were set out like stars in array, cutting off his supply lines; the bandits grew ever more distressed.
translations.idiomatic: Chun won over Abao and his fellows, tracked Azi's movements, and dotted the landscape with garrison forts that strangled his supply lines, leaving the rebels increasingly desperate.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，福潛引兵屯赤窩鋪，遣百戶張忠等搗賊巢，擒阿資，斬之，俘其黨，越州乃平。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, Fu secretly led troops to encamp at Chiwopu, dispatching centurion Zhang Zhong and others to storm the bandits' nest; Azi was captured and beheaded; his followers were taken prisoner; Yue Prefecture was then pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 28 He Fu quietly moved troops to Chiwopu and sent Centurion Zhang Zhong to strike Azi's stronghold. Azi was seized and executed, his followers captured, and Yue Prefecture was finally pacified.

sentences.zh: 自是以後，諸土官按期朝貢，西南晏然。

translations.literal: From then on, the various native officials paid court tribute on schedule, and the southwest was tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the native officials sent tribute on time, and the southwest enjoyed a lasting calm.

sentences.zh: 正統二年，曲靖軍民知府晏毅言四事：一，土官承襲，或子孫，或兄弟，或妻繼夫，或妾繼嫡，皆無豫定次序，致臨襲爭奪，仇殺連年。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhengtong, military-civilian prefect Yan Yi of Qujing spoke of four matters: First, in native-official succession — whether by descendants, brothers, a wife succeeding her husband, or a concubine succeeding the principal wife — there was no predetermined order, causing struggles at the time of succession and vengeance killing year after year.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengtong 2 Qujing's military-civilian prefect Yan Yi raised four proposals. First, native-official succession — whether to a son, brother, widow, or concubine elevated over the principal wife — followed no fixed order, provoking bloody struggles every time a post fell vacant.

sentences.zh: 乞敕該部移文所司，豫為定序造冊，土官有故，如序襲職。

translations.literal: He requested that the relevant ministry be ordered to send documents to the responsible offices to predetermine the order and compile registers, so that when a native official died, succession would follow the order.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that the ministry issue instructions to local authorities to draw up registers fixing the line of succession in advance, so that vacancies would be filled according to plan.

sentences.zh: 一，請恤陣亡子孫。

translations.literal: Second, he requested relief for the descendants of those killed in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Second, he sought pensions for the families of men killed in action.

sentences.zh: 一，請雲南官俸，悉如四川之例。

translations.literal: Third, he requested that official salaries in Yunnan all follow the Sichuan precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Third, he asked that Yunnan official salaries be brought into line with Sichuan rates.

sentences.zh: 一，均戶口田地。

translations.literal: Fourth, equalize registered households and farmland.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, he proposed an equitable redistribution of registered households and farmland.

sentences.zh: 事下所司議行。

translations.literal: The matters were referred to the responsible offices for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The proposals were forwarded to the relevant departments for review and action.

sentences.zh: 毅復請設沾益州松韶巡檢，從之。

translations.literal: Yi again requested the establishment of the Songsao inspection post in Zhanyi Prefecture; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Yi also petitioned for a Songsao inspection post in Zhanyi Prefecture, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖中，羅雄知州者浚殺營長，奪其妻，生子繼榮，稍長即持刀逐浚。

translations.literal: During the Jiajing era, Luoxiong Prefect Zhe Jun killed a camp chief, seized his wife, and fathered a son Jirong; when the boy grew somewhat older he took up a knife and drove Jun away.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jiajing period Luoxiong Prefect Zhe Jun murdered a camp chief and took the man's wife, who bore him a son named Jirong. As soon as the boy was old enough he seized a blade and chased Jun from the house.

sentences.zh: 浚欲置之死，以其母故不忍。

translations.literal: Jun wished to put him to death but, because of his mother, could not bear to do so.
translations.idiomatic: Jun wanted the boy dead but spared him for his mother's sake.

sentences.zh: 及浚請老，以繼榮代襲，繼榮遂逐浚。

translations.literal: When Jun requested retirement, Jirong was appointed to succeed in his stead; Jirong then drove Jun away.
translations.idiomatic: When Jun petitioned to retire and Jirong inherited the post, the son promptly expelled his father.

sentences.zh: 浚訴之鎮巡官，命迎浚歸。

translations.literal: Jun complained to the provincial inspection officials, who ordered that Jun be welcomed back.
translations.idiomatic: Jun appealed to the provincial overseers, who ordered Jirong to bring his father home.

sentences.zh: 繼榮陽事之，實加禁錮。

translations.literal: Jirong outwardly served him but in fact placed him under confinement.
translations.idiomatic: Jirong feigned obedience while secretly keeping his father under house arrest.

sentences.zh: 萬歷九年調羅雄兵征緬。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Wanli, Luoxiong troops were mobilized to campaign against Burma.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 9 Luoxiong forces were called up for the Burma campaign.

sentences.zh: 繼榮將行，恐留浚為難，遂弒浚。

translations.literal: As Jirong was about to depart, fearing that leaving Jun behind would cause trouble, he assassinated Jun.
translations.idiomatic: On the eve of departure Jirong, fearing his father might make trouble in his absence, murdered him.

sentences.zh: 時沾益土知州安世鼎死，妻安素儀署州事，亦提兵赴調。

translations.literal: At the time the native prefect of Zhanyi, An Shiding, had died; his wife An Suyi acted in his stead administering the prefecture and also led troops to answer the mobilization.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Zhanyi's native prefect An Shiding had died, and his widow An Suyi governed in his place while also marching troops to the campaign.

sentences.zh: 繼榮與之合營，通焉，且倚沾益兵力為助。

translations.literal: Jirong joined camps with her, kept intimate relations with her, and moreover relied on Zhanyi's military strength as aid.
translations.idiomatic: Jirong encamped alongside her, entered into an affair with her, and leaned on Zhanyi's troops for support.

sentences.zh: 師過越州，留土官資氏家，淫樂不進。

translations.literal: When the army passed through Yue Prefecture, they stayed at the home of native official Lady Zi, indulging in licentious pleasure and not advancing.
translations.idiomatic: Marching through Yue Prefecture, the column halted at the house of a native official surnamed Zi and lingered there in debauchery rather than pressing on.

sentences.zh: 知州越應奎白於兵備，將擒之，繼榮走，遂聚眾反。

translations.literal: Subprefect Yue Yingkui reported to the military preparations office that he was about to seize him; Jirong fled, then gathered troops and rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Subprefect Yue Yingkui reported to the military preparations office that he was about to arrest Jirong. Jirong fled, gathered followers, and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 攻破陸涼鴨子塘、陡陂諸寨，築石城於赤龍山，據龍潭為險，廣六十里。

translations.literal: He stormed the stockades of Yazitang and Doupo in Luliang, built a stone city on Chilong Mountain, held Longtan as a strongpoint, and extended sixty li.
translations.idiomatic: He stormed the stockades of Yazitang and Doupo in Luliang, built a stone fortress on Chilong Mountain, held Longtan as his strongpoint, and controlled an area sixty li across.

sentences.zh: 名己所居曰「龍樓鳳閣」，環以群寨，實諸軍士妻女其中。

translations.literal: He named his dwelling "Dragon Tower and Phoenix Pavilion," surrounded it with stockades, and settled the wives and daughters of his soldiers within.
translations.idiomatic: He named his residence "Dragon Tower and Phoenix Pavilion," ringed it with stockades, and settled his soldiers' wives and daughters inside.

sentences.zh: 十三年，巡撫劉世曾乃檄諸道進兵。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Grand Coordinator Liu Shizeng issued orders to the various circuits to advance troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Grand Coordinator Liu Shizeng ordered the various circuits to advance their troops.

sentences.zh: 適劉綎破緬解官回，世曾以兵屬綎。

translations.literal: It happened that Liu Ting had defeated Burma and returned after being relieved of office; Shizeng placed the troops under Ting's command.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ting had just defeated Burma and returned after being relieved of command, and Shizeng placed the troops under him.

sentences.zh: 綎遂馳赴普鲊營，直搗赤龍寨，斬賊渠帥，繼榮遁去。

translations.literal: Ting then galloped to the Puzha camp, struck straight at Chilong Stockade, beheaded the rebel chieftains, and Jirong fled.
translations.idiomatic: Ting galloped to the Puzha camp, struck straight at Chilong Stockade, beheaded the rebel chieftains, and Jirong fled.

sentences.zh: 綎復連破三寨，降其眾一萬七千人，追奔至阿拜江，斬繼榮，賊平。

translations.literal: Ting again took three stockades in succession, reduced seventeen thousand of their followers, pursued in flight to the Abai River, beheaded Jirong, and the bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Ting took three more stockades in succession, accepted the surrender of seventeen thousand followers, pursued the fugitives to the Abai River, beheaded Jirong, and the rebellion was pacified.

sentences.zh: 世曾請築城，改設流官，乃以何倓為知州，者繼仁為巡檢。

translations.literal: Shizeng requested building a city and changing to regular officials; He Tan was made subprefect and Zhe Jiren inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Shizeng requested building a walled city and installing regular officials. He Tan was appointed subprefect and Zhe Jiren inspector.

sentences.zh: 未幾，蠻寇必大反，殺繼仁，執倓。

translations.literal: Before long the barbarian bandit Bidafan rebelled, killed Jiren, and seized Tan.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the barbarian chieftain Bidafan rebelled, killed Jiren, and seized Tan.

sentences.zh: 參將蔡兆吉等討定之，乃改羅雄州曰羅平，設千戶所曰定雄。

translations.literal: Vice Commander Cai Zhaoji and others suppressed and pacified them; Luoxiong Prefecture was then changed to Luoping and a thousand-household office called Dingxiong was established.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Commander Cai Zhaoji and others suppressed the rebellion. Luoxiong Prefecture was renamed Luoping, and a thousand-household office called Dingxiong was established.

sentences.zh: 時沾益安素儀無子，以烏撒土官子安紹慶為嗣。

translations.literal: At the time An Suyi of Zhanyi had no son and took An Shaoqing, son of the Wusa native official, as heir.
translations.idiomatic: At the time An Suyi of Zhanyi had no son and adopted An Shaoqing, son of the Wusa native official, as his heir.

sentences.zh: 慶死，孫安遠襲。

translations.literal: When Qing died, his grandson An Yuan succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Shaoqing died, his grandson An Yuan succeeded.

sentences.zh: 土婦設科作亂，逐安遠，糾眾焚掠沾益諸堡站，陷平夷衛。

translations.literal: The native woman She Ke rebelled, drove out An Yuan, gathered followers to burn and plunder the forts and stations of Zhanyi, and took Pingyi Guard.
translations.idiomatic: The native woman She Ke rebelled, drove out An Yuan, gathered followers to burn and plunder the forts and stations of Zhanyi, and captured Pingyi Guard.

sentences.zh: 天啟三年，官兵擒設科，誅之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tianqi, government troops captured She Ke and put her to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tianqi, government troops captured She Ke and executed her.

sentences.zh: 五年，安邊據沾益，從水西叛。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, An Bian held Zhanyi and followed Shuixi in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, An Bian seized Zhanyi and joined the Shuixi rebellion.

sentences.zh: 事詳《烏撒傳》中。

translations.literal: The affair is detailed in the Wusa biography.
translations.idiomatic: The affair is treated in detail in the biography of Wusa.

sentences.zh: 初，越州阿資罪誅，永樂間以其子祿寧為土縣丞，與亦佐沙氏分土而居。

translations.literal: At first, when Azi of Yue Prefecture was executed for crime, in Yongle his son Lu Ning was made native assistant magistrate and divided the land to dwell with the Sha clan of Yizuo.
translations.idiomatic: After Azi of Yue Prefecture was executed for his crimes, his son Lu Ning was made native assistant magistrate in the Yongle reign and shared the territory with the Sha clan of Yizuo.

sentences.zh: 其地南北一百二十里，士馬精強，征調銀至三千八百兩。

translations.literal: Its territory extended one hundred twenty li north and south; its soldiers and horses were elite and strong; levied silver reached three thousand eight hundred taels.
translations.idiomatic: Its territory stretched one hundred twenty li from north to south. Its troops and horses were formidable, and its silver levies reached three thousand eight hundred taels.

sentences.zh: 曲靖境內有交水，去平夷衛二舍，與黔接壤，滇師出上六衛必由之道。

translations.literal: Within Qujing territory is Jiaoshui, two stages from Pingyi Guard, bordering Guizhou — the road Yunnan armies of the upper six guards must take.
translations.idiomatic: Within Qujing lies Jiaoshui, two stages from Pingyi Guard on the Guizhou border — the route armies from Yunnan's upper six guards must take when marching out.

sentences.zh: 天啟初，水西用兵，撫臣議：「曲靖鎖鑰全滇，交水當黔、滇之沖，乃厄塞要地。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianqi, when troops were used in Shuixi, the grand coordinator proposed: "Qujing is the lock on all Yunnan; Jiaoshui stands at the thrust between Guizhou and Yunnan — a chokepoint of vital ground.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Tianqi, during the Shuixi campaign, the grand coordinator proposed: "Qujing is the key to all Yunnan. Jiaoshui stands at the crossing between Guizhou and Yunnan — a vital chokepoint.

sentences.zh: 平夷右所宜移置交水，去險築城，俾與平夷衛相望，互為聲援，便。」

translations.literal: The right battalion of Pingyi should be moved to Jiaoshui, leave the perilous ground and build a city, so that it faces Pingyi Guard across the distance and they support one another — this would be convenient."
translations.idiomatic: The right battalion of Pingyi should be relocated to Jiaoshui, leave the difficult ground, and build a city facing Pingyi Guard so the two posts could support each other. That would be advantageous.

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: The reply was: approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.
